```{r General DIY function}
fxx.mouse2human <- function(mouse_entrez) {
  if (!requireNamespace("biomaRt", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package biomaRt is required but not installed")
  }
  
  mouse <- biomaRt::useMart("ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl")
  human <- biomaRt::useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
  
  genes_conv <- biomaRt::getLDS(
    attributes = c("entrezgene_id"),
    filters = "entrezgene_id",
    values = mouse_entrez,
    mart = mouse,
    attributesL = c("entrezgene_id"),
    martL = human
  )
  
  unique(genes_conv[, 2])
}
fxx.human2mouse_local <- function(human_symbols) {
  if (!requireNamespace("homologene", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package homologene is required but not installed")
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    human_symbols <- tolower(human_symbols)
    hdata <- homologene::homologene
    
    human_mouse <- hdata[hdata$tax_id %in% c(9606, 10090), ]
    
    conversion_table <- human_mouse %>%
      dplyr::select(tax_id, gene_symbol) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = tax_id,
        values_from = gene_symbol,
        names_prefix = "tax_"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(human = tax_9606, mouse = tax_10090) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(human) & !is.na(mouse))
    
    mouse_symbols <- sapply(human_symbols, function(x) {
      match_idx <- which(tolower(conversion_table$human) == x)
      if (length(match_idx) > 0) {
        conversion_table$mouse[match_idx[1]]
      } else {
        NA
      }
    })
    
    mouse_symbols[is.na(mouse_symbols)] <- human_symbols[is.na(mouse_symbols)]
    mouse_symbols
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in homologene conversion:", e$message))
    human_symbols
  })
}
fxx.mouse2human_local <- function(mouse_entrez, gene_symbols = NULL) {
  if (!requireNamespace("homologene", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package homologene is required but not installed")
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    human_genes <- homologene::mouse2human(as.character(mouse_entrez))
    
    if (length(human_genes) > 0) {
      human_genes
    } else {
      if (!is.null(gene_symbols)) {
        toupper(gene_symbols)
      } else {
        NULL
      }
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    if (!is.null(gene_symbols)) {
      toupper(gene_symbols)
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  })
}
fxx.run_enrichment_multibase <- function(genes,
                                           species = c("human", "mouse"),
                                           p_cutoff = 0.05,
                                           q_cutoff = 1) {
    
    required_packages <- c("dplyr", "org.Hs.eg.db", "org.Mm.eg.db", "clusterProfiler", 
                           "DOSE", "ReactomePA", "parallel")
  
    for(pkg in required_packages) {
      if(!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
        stop(paste("Package", pkg, "is required but not installed"))
      }
      library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
    }
    
    species <- match.arg(species, choices = c("human", "mouse"))
    if(length(genes) == 0) {
      stop("No genes provided for enrichment analysis")
    }
    
    
    species_params <- list(
      human = list(
        org_db = "org.Hs.eg.db",
        kegg_org = "hsa",
        reactome_org = "human",
        wp_org = "Homo sapiens"
      ),
      mouse = list(
        org_db = "org.Mm.eg.db", 
        kegg_org = "mmu",
        reactome_org = "mouse",
        wp_org = "Mus musculus"
      )
    )[[species]]
    
    
    required_packages <- c("dplyr", species_params$org_db, "clusterProfiler", 
                           "DOSE", "ReactomePA", "parallel")
    for(pkg in required_packages) {
      if(!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
        stop(paste("Package", pkg, "is required but not installed"))
      }
    }
    
    
    target_entrez <- tryCatch({
      bitr(genes,
           fromType = "SYMBOL",
           toType = "ENTREZID",
           OrgDb = species_params$org_db)
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Error in ID conversion: ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    if(is.null(target_entrez)) {
      stop("Failed to convert gene symbols to ENTREZ IDs")
    }
    
    
    enrichment_functions <- list(
      eego = function() {
        enrichGO(gene          = target_entrez$ENTREZID,
                 OrgDb         = get(species_params$org_db),
                 ont           = "ALL",
                 pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
                 pvalueCutoff  = p_cutoff,
                 qvalueCutoff  = q_cutoff,
                 readable      = TRUE)
      },
      eekegg = function() {
        enrichKEGG(gene = target_entrez$ENTREZID,
                   organism = species_params$kegg_org,
                   pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                   qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff,
                   pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
                   minGSSize = 10,
                   maxGSSize = 500)
      },
      eerea = function() {
        enrichPathway(gene = target_entrez$ENTREZID,
                      organism = species_params$reactome_org,
                      pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                      qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff,
                      readable = TRUE)
      },
      eewp = function() {
        enrichWP(gene = target_entrez$ENTREZID,
                 organism = species_params$wp_org,
                 pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                 qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff)
      }
    )
    
  
    if(species == "human") {
      enrichment_functions$eedo <- function() {
        enrichDO(gene          = target_entrez$ENTREZID,
                 ont           = "DO",
                 pvalueCutoff  = p_cutoff,
                 pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
                 minGSSize     = 10,
                 maxGSSize     = 500,
                 qvalueCutoff  = q_cutoff,
                 readable      = FALSE)
      }
      
      enrichment_functions$eencg <- function() {
        enrichNCG(gene = target_entrez$ENTREZID,
                  pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                  qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff)
      }
      
      enrichment_functions$eedgn <- function() {
        enrichDGN(gene = target_entrez$ENTREZID,
                  pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                  qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff)
      }
    } else if(species == "mouse") {
      
      enrichment_functions$eedo <- function() {
        human_orthologs <- fxx.mouse2human(target_entrez$ENTREZID)
        if(!is.null(human_orthologs)) {
          enrichDO(gene = human_orthologs,
                   ont = "DO",
                   pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                   pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
                   minGSSize = 10,
                   maxGSSize = 500,
                   qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff,
                   readable = FALSE)
        } else NULL
      }
      
      enrichment_functions$eencg <- function() {
        human_orthologs <- fxx.mouse2human(target_entrez$ENTREZID)
        if(!is.null(human_orthologs)) {
          enrichNCG(gene = human_orthologs,
                    pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                    qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff)
        } else NULL
      }
      
      enrichment_functions$eedgn <- function() {
        human_orthologs <- fxx.mouse2human(target_entrez$ENTREZID)
        if(!is.null(human_orthologs)) {
          enrichDGN(gene = human_orthologs,
                    pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                    qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff)
        } else NULL
      }
    }
    
    
    n_cores <- min(parallel::detectCores() - 1, length(enrichment_functions))
    
    
    cl <- parallel::makeCluster(n_cores)
    on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl))
    
    
    parallel::clusterExport(cl, c("target_entrez", "p_cutoff", "q_cutoff", "species_params"))
    parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl, {
      library(clusterProfiler)
      library(DOSE)
      library(ReactomePA)
    })
    
    
    enrichment_results <- parallel::parLapply(cl, enrichment_functions, function(fun) {
      tryCatch(fun(), error = function(e) {
        message("Enrichment analysis failed: ", e$message)
        NULL
      })
    })
    
    
    df_results <- list()
    enrichment_results_after_df <- list()
    
    for(name in names(enrichment_results)) {
      result <- enrichment_results[[name]]
      if(!is.null(result) && nrow(result) > 0) {
        
        df_results[[name]] <- result %>% as.data.frame()
        
        
        display_name <- switch(name,
                               "eego" = "GO",
                               "eekegg" = "KEGG",
                               "eerea" = "Reactome",
                               "eedo" = "DO",
                               "eewp" = "WikiPathways",
                               "eencg" = "NCG",
                               "eedgn" = "DGN")
        
        enrichment_results_after_df[[display_name]] <- df_results[[name]]
      }
    }
    
    
    return(list(
      original_results = enrichment_results,
      df_results = df_results,
      formatted_results = enrichment_results_after_df
    ))
  }
fxx.run_enrichment_multibase.uniLine <- function(genes,
                                             species = c("human", "mouse"),
                                             p_cutoff = 0.05,
                                             q_cutoff = 1,
                                             timeout = 120) {
    
    species <- match.arg(species)
    species_params <- list(
        human = list(
            org_db = "org.Hs.eg.db",
            kegg_org = "hsa",
            reactome_org = "human",
            wp_org = "Homo sapiens"
        ),
        mouse = list(
            org_db = "org.Mm.eg.db", 
            kegg_org = "mmu",
            reactome_org = "mouse",
            wp_org = "Mus musculus"
        )
    )[[species]]
    
    
    target_entrez <- tryCatch({
        bitr(genes,
             fromType = "SYMBOL",
             toType = "ENTREZID",
             OrgDb = species_params$org_db)
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("Error in gene ID conversion: ", e$message)
        return(NULL)
    })
    
    if(is.null(target_entrez) || nrow(target_entrez) == 0) {
        message("Failed to convert any gene symbols to ENTREZ IDs")
        return(list(
            original_results = list(),
            df_results = list()
        ))
    }
    
    results <- list()

    options(timeout = timeout)
    
    
    results$GO <- tryCatch({
        enrichGO(gene = target_entrez$ENTREZID,
                 OrgDb = get(species_params$org_db),
                 ont = "ALL",
                 pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
                 pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                 qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff,
                 readable = TRUE)
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("GO enrichment analysis failed: ", e$message)
        return(NULL)
    })
    
    #  KEGG
    results$KEGG <- tryCatch({
        enrichKEGG(gene = target_entrez$ENTREZID,
                   organism = species_params$kegg_org,
                   pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                   qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff)
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("KEGG enrichment analysis failed: ", e$message)
        return(NULL)
    })
    
    #  Reactome
    results$Reactome <- tryCatch({
        enrichPathway(gene = target_entrez$ENTREZID,
                      organism = species_params$reactome_org,
                      pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                      qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff,
                      readable = TRUE)
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("Reactome enrichment analysis failed: ", e$message)
        return(NULL)
    })
    
    #  WikiPathways
    results$WikiPathways <- tryCatch({
        enrichWP(gene = target_entrez$ENTREZID,
                 organism = species_params$wp_org,
                 pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                 qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff)
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("WikiPathways enrichment analysis failed: ", e$message)
        return(NULL)
    })
    
    
    if(species == "human") {
        # Disease Ontology
        results$DO <- tryCatch({
            enrichDO(gene = target_entrez$ENTREZID,
                     ont = "DO",
                     pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                     qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff,
                     readable = TRUE)
        }, error = function(e) {
            message("DO enrichment analysis failed: ", e$message)
            return(NULL)
        })
        
        # NCG
        results$NCG <- tryCatch({
            enrichNCG(gene = target_entrez$ENTREZID,
                      pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                      qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff)
        }, error = function(e) {
            message("NCG enrichment analysis failed: ", e$message)
            return(NULL)
        })
        
        # DisGeNET
        results$DGN <- tryCatch({
            enrichDGN(gene = target_entrez$ENTREZID,
                      pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                      qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff)
        }, error = function(e) {
            message("DGN enrichment analysis failed: ", e$message)
            return(NULL)
        })
    } else {
        
        human_orthologs_df <- tryCatch({
            fxx.mouse2human_local(target_entrez$ENTREZID, 
                                 gene_symbols = target_entrez$SYMBOL)
        }, error = function(e) {
            message("Error converting mouse genes to human orthologs: ", e$message)
            return(NULL)
        })
        
        if(!is.null(human_orthologs_df)) {
            human_orthologs <- human_orthologs_df$humanID
            
            
            results$DO <- tryCatch({
                enrichDO(gene = human_orthologs,
                         ont = "DO",
                         pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                         qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff,
                         readable = TRUE)
            }, error = function(e) {
                message("DO enrichment analysis failed: ", e$message)
                return(NULL)
            })
            
            
            results$NCG <- tryCatch({
                enrichNCG(gene = human_orthologs,
                          pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                          qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff)
            }, error = function(e) {
                message("NCG enrichment analysis failed: ", e$message)
                return(NULL)
            })
            
            # DisGeNET
            results$DGN <- tryCatch({
                enrichDGN(gene = human_orthologs,
                          pvalueCutoff = p_cutoff,
                          qvalueCutoff = q_cutoff)
            }, error = function(e) {
                message("DGN enrichment analysis failed: ", e$message)
                return(NULL)
            })
        }
    }
    
    
    options(timeout = 60)  
    
    
    df_results <- list()
    for(name in names(results)) {
        result <- results[[name]]
        if(!is.null(result) && methods::is(result, "enrichResult") && nrow(result) > 0) {
            df_results[[name]] <- as.data.frame(result)
        }
    }
    
    if(length(df_results) == 0) {
        message("No successful enrichment results were obtained.")
    } else {
        message(sprintf("Successfully completed %d out of %d enrichment analyses.", 
                       length(df_results), length(results)))
    }
    
    return(list(
        original_results = results,
        df_results = df_results
    ))
}
fxx.save_enrichment_to_excel <- function(filtered_results, filename, out_dir) {
  
  if(!exists("setwd")) {
    message("setwd() not found, sourcing from code folder...")
    setwd(file.path(root_path, code_folder))
    source("setwd.R")
    message("Successfully loaded setwd()")
  }
  setwd(out_dir)
  
  wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  wb_combined <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  
  for(cluster_name in names(filtered_results)) {
    combined_df <- NULL
    all_columns <- c() 
    
    for(db in names(filtered_results[[cluster_name]])) {
      curr_results <- filtered_results[[cluster_name]][[db]]
      if(!is.null(curr_results) && nrow(curr_results) > 0) {
        all_columns <- union(all_columns, colnames(curr_results))
      }
    }
    
    for(db in names(filtered_results[[cluster_name]])) {
      curr_results <- filtered_results[[cluster_name]][[db]]
      
      if(!is.null(curr_results) && nrow(curr_results) > 0) {
        
        curr_df <- curr_results
        
        
        col_mapping <- list(
          # GO/KEGG/Reactome
          "ID" = c("ID", "GOID", "KEGGID", "ReactomeID"),
          "Description" = c("Description", "Term", "Pathway", "PathwayName"),
          "GeneRatio" = c("GeneRatio", "Gene_Ratio"),
          "BgRatio" = c("BgRatio", "Bg_Ratio"),
          "pvalue" = c("pvalue", "PValue", "P.Value"),
          "p.adjust" = c("p.adjust", "adj.P.Val", "padj"),
          "qvalue" = c("qvalue", "FDR"),
          "geneID" = c("geneID", "Genes", "gene"),
          "Count" = c("Count", "Size", "N")
        )
        
        for(std_col in names(col_mapping)) {
          matched_col <- intersect(col_mapping[[std_col]], colnames(curr_df))
          if(length(matched_col) > 0) {
            colnames(curr_df)[colnames(curr_df) == matched_col[1]] <- std_col
          }
        }
        
        for(col in all_columns) {
          if(!(col %in% colnames(curr_df))) {
            curr_df[[col]] <- NA
          }
        }
        
        sheet_name <- paste0(cluster_name, "_", db)
        openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
        openxlsx::writeData(wb, sheet_name, x = curr_results) 
        openxlsx::addFilter(wb, sheet_name, row = 1, cols = 1:ncol(curr_results))
        openxlsx::freezePane(wb, sheet_name, firstRow = TRUE)
        openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, sheet_name, cols = 1:ncol(curr_results), widths = "auto")
        
        
        curr_df$database <- db
        if(is.null(combined_df)) {
          combined_df <- curr_df
        } else {
          
          missing_cols <- setdiff(colnames(curr_df), colnames(combined_df))
          for(col in missing_cols) {
            combined_df[[col]] <- NA
          }
          missing_cols <- setdiff(colnames(combined_df), colnames(curr_df))
          for(col in missing_cols) {
            curr_df[[col]] <- NA
          }
          
          
          curr_df <- curr_df[, colnames(combined_df)]
          combined_df <- rbind(combined_df, curr_df)
        }
      }
    }
    
    
    if(!is.null(combined_df) && nrow(combined_df) > 0) {
      
      important_cols <- c("ID", "Description", "GeneRatio", "BgRatio", 
                          "pvalue", "p.adjust", "qvalue", "Count", "geneID", "database")
      other_cols <- setdiff(colnames(combined_df), important_cols)
      other_cols <- sort(other_cols)
      col_order <- c(important_cols[important_cols %in% colnames(combined_df)], 
                     other_cols)
      
      
      combined_df <- combined_df[order(combined_df$p.adjust), ]
      combined_df <- combined_df[, col_order]
      
      
      openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb_combined, cluster_name)
      openxlsx::writeData(wb_combined, cluster_name, x = combined_df)
      openxlsx::addFilter(wb_combined, cluster_name, row = 1, cols = 1:ncol(combined_df))
      openxlsx::freezePane(wb_combined, cluster_name, firstRow = TRUE)
      openxlsx::setColWidths(wb_combined, cluster_name, cols = 1:ncol(combined_df), widths = "auto")
    }
  }
  
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, paste0(filename, "_pathways.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb_combined, paste0(filename, "_pathways_combined.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
  
  message(sprintf("Results have been saved to:\n%s\n%s", 
                  paste0(filename, "_pathways.xlsx"),
                  paste0(filename, "_pathways_combined.xlsx")))
}

# Save plot as PNG and PDF
fxx.save_plot <- function(plot, filename, height, width, dpi = 300) {
  height_px <- height * dpi
  width_px <- width * dpi

  png(
    filename = paste0(filename, ".png"),
    height = height_px,
    width = width_px,
    units = "px",
    res = dpi
  )

  if (inherits(plot, "ggplot")) {
    print(plot)
  } else if (inherits(plot, "gList")) {
    grid.draw(plot)
  } else if (inherits(plot, "pheatmap")) {
    grid.draw(plot$gtable)
  } else {
    grid.draw(plot)
  }

  dev.off()

  pdf(
    file = paste0(filename, ".pdf"),
    height = height,
    width = width
  )

  if (inherits(plot, "ggplot")) {
    print(plot)
  } else if (inherits(plot, "gList")) {
    grid.draw(plot)
  } else if (inherits(plot, "pheatmap")) {
    grid.draw(plot$gtable)
  } else {
    grid.draw(plot)
  }

  dev.off()

library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)

fxx.seuratPreProcess <- function(obj, selectionMethod="vst", nFindVariableFeatures=2000, dims=1:10, res=0.5, seed=1){
  set.seed(seed)
  # perform standard Seurat preprocessing 
  # (Normalization, Scaling, Dimensionality Reduction, Clustering)
  obj <- NormalizeData(obj)
  obj <- ScaleData(obj, verbose=FALSE)
  obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, selection.method=selectionMethod, nfeatures=nFindVariableFeatures)
  obj <- RunPCA(obj)
  obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims=dims)
  obj <- RunTSNE(obj, dims=dims)
  obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims=dims)
  
  # FindCluster for every resolution
  for(r in res) {
    obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution=r, random.seed=seed)
  }
  
  return(obj)
}

library(homologene)

fxx.human2mouse_local <- function(human_symbols) {
  if (!requireNamespace("homologene", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package homologene is required but not installed")
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    human_symbols <- tolower(human_symbols)
    
    hdata <- homologene::homologene
    
    human_mouse <- hdata[hdata$tax_id %in% c(9606, 10090), ]
    
    conversion_table <- human_mouse %>%
      dplyr::select(tax_id, gene_symbol) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = tax_id,
        values_from = gene_symbol,
        names_prefix = "tax_"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(human = tax_9606, mouse = tax_10090) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(human) & !is.na(mouse))
    
    mouse_symbols <- sapply(human_symbols, function(x) {
      match_idx <- which(tolower(conversion_table$human) == x)
      if (length(match_idx) > 0) {
        return(conversion_table$mouse[match_idx[1]])
      } else {
        return(NA)
      }
    })
    
    mouse_symbols[is.na(mouse_symbols)] <- human_symbols[is.na(mouse_symbols)]
    
    return(mouse_symbols)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in homologene conversion:", e$message))
    return(human_symbols)
  })
}

fxx.mouse2human_local <- function(mouse_entrez, gene_symbols = NULL) {
  if (!requireNamespace("homologene", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package homologene is required but not installed")
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    human_genes <- homologene::mouse2human(as.character(mouse_entrez))
    
    if (length(human_genes) > 0) {
      return(human_genes)
    } else {
      if (!is.null(gene_symbols)) {
        return(toupper(gene_symbols))
      } else {
        return(NULL)
      }
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    if (!is.null(gene_symbols)) {
      return(toupper(gene_symbols))
    } else {
      return(NULL)
    }
  })
}
```

```{r Macrophage/Monocyte subset annotation}
##==================================##
## Program: Selected pathway processing pipeline
##==================================##

# Required packages
library(msigdbr)
library(KEGGREST)
library(GO.db)
library(ReactomePA)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(DOSE)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(openxlsx)

#---- Functions for retrieving gene sets from different databases ----#

# Retrieve KEGG gene sets
fxx.get_kegg_genesets <- function(pathway_ids, species = c("mouse", "human", "rat")) {
  species <- match.arg(species)

  species_params <- list(
    mouse = list(
      prefix = "mmu",
      org_db = "org.Mm.eg.db"
    ),
    human = list(
      prefix = "hsa",
      org_db = "org.Hs.eg.db"
    ),
    rat = list(
      prefix = "rno",
      org_db = "org.Rn.eg.db"
    )
  )[[species]]

  kegg_genesets <- list()

  for (pathway_id in pathway_ids) {
    tryCatch({
      if (!grepl(paste0("^", species_params$prefix), pathway_id)) {
        pathway_id <- paste0(species_params$prefix, pathway_id)
      }

      pathway_info <- keggGet(pathway_id)[[1]]

      if (!is.null(pathway_info$GENE)) {
        genes <- pathway_info$GENE[seq(2, length(pathway_info$GENE), 2)]
        genes <- sapply(strsplit(genes, ";"), function(x) trimws(x[1]))
        kegg_genesets[[pathway_info$NAME]] <- genes
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(sprintf("Error processing pathway %s: %s", pathway_id, e$message))
    })
  }

  return(kegg_genesets)
}

# Retrieve GO gene sets
fxx.get_go_genesets <- function(go_ids,
                                species = c("mouse", "human", "rat"),
                                ont = c("ALL", "BP", "MF", "CC")) {
  species <- match.arg(species)
  ont <- match.arg(ont)

  species_params <- list(
    mouse = list(
      org_db = "org.Mm.eg.db"
    ),
    human = list(
      org_db = "org.Hs.eg.db"
    ),
    rat = list(
      org_db = "org.Rn.eg.db"
    )
  )[[species]]

  go_genesets <- list()

  for (go_id in go_ids) {
    tryCatch({
      genes <- AnnotationDbi::select(
        get(species_params$org_db),
        keys = go_id,
        columns = c("SYMBOL"),
        keytype = "GOALL"
      )

      term_name <- AnnotationDbi::select(
        GO.db,
        keys = go_id,
        columns = "TERM",
        keytype = "GOID"
      )$TERM

      if (ont != "ALL") {
        term_ont <- AnnotationDbi::select(
          GO.db,
          keys = go_id,
          columns = "ONTOLOGY",
          keytype = "GOID"
        )$ONTOLOGY

        if (term_ont != ont) {
          next
        }
      }

      if (nrow(genes) > 0) {
        go_genesets[[term_name]] <- unique(genes$SYMBOL)
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(sprintf("Error processing GO term %s: %s", go_id, e$message))
    })
  }

  return(go_genesets)
}

#---- Read and process Excel file ----#

out_dir <- "11.4.Selected_pathways"

selected_pathways_file <- "selected_pathways.xlsx"
sheets <- openxlsx::getSheetNames(selected_pathways_file)

all_genesets <- list()

for (sheet in sheets) {
  pathway_data <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(selected_pathways_file, sheet = sheet)

  genesets <- switch(
    toupper(sheet),
    "KEGG" = fxx.get_kegg_genesets(pathway_data$ID),
    "GO" = fxx.get_go_genesets(pathway_data$ID),
    NULL
  )

  if (!is.null(genesets) && length(genesets) > 0) {
    rds_file <- paste0(tolower(sheet), "_selected_pathways.rds")
    saveRDS(genesets, file = rds_file)
    all_genesets[[sheet]] <- genesets
  } else {
    warning(sprintf("No gene sets found for database: %s", sheet))
  }
}

saveRDS(all_genesets, "all_selected_pathways.rds")

# Optional check

#---- Plotting functions ----#

fxx_dotplot.ListANDDuplicated <- function(seurat_obj, group_by, marker_list) {
  library(Seurat)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)

  p_list <- list()
  widths <- vector()

  for (i in seq_along(marker_list)) {
    gene_set <- marker_list[[i]]
    set_name <- names(marker_list)[i]

    pp <- DotPlot(
      seurat_obj,
      features = gene_set,
      group.by = group_by,
      cols = c("#ffffff", "#448444")
    ) +
      RotatedAxis() +
      theme(
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black"),
        panel.spacing = unit(1, "mm"),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 9)
      ) +
      ggtitle(set_name)

    if (i == length(marker_list)) {
      pp <- pp + theme(legend.position = "right")
    }

    p_list[[i]] <- pp
    widths <- c(widths, length(gene_set))
  }

  p <- wrap_plots(plotlist = p_list) +
    plot_layout(widths = widths)

  return(p)
}

fxx.dotplot <- function(seurat_obj, group_by, marker_list) {
  library(ggplot2)
  library(Seurat)

  pp <- DotPlot(
    seurat_obj,
    features = marker_list,
    group.by = group_by,
    cols = c("#ffffff", "#448444")
  ) +
    RotatedAxis() +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black"),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "mm"),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  return(pp)
}
```

```{r Macrophage/Monocyte subset visualization}
fxx.get_many_color <-function(num = 10){
  library(ggsci)
  if(num<11) return( pal_npg()(num) )
  if(num<21) return( c( pal_npg()(10),pal_futurama()(num-10) ) )
  if(num>20) return( c(
    pal_futurama()(10),
    pal_uchicago()(9),
    pal_cosmic("hallmarks_light")(10),
    pal_locuszoom()(7),
    pal_jco()(10),
    pal_jama()(7),
    pal_aaas()(10),
    pal_nejm()(8),
    pal_npg()(10)
  ) )
}  


fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res <- function(final_folder, p_filename, p=last_plot(), height, width, dpi = 600){
  if(!dir.exists( file.path( root_path, res_folder, final_folder) )){
    dir.create(file.path( root_path, res_folder, final_folder))
  }
  
  setwd(file.path( root_path, res_folder, final_folder))
  p_filename <- str_c(p_filename)
  ggsave(plot = p, filename = str_c(p_filename, ".png"), height = height, width = width, units = "in", dpi = dpi)
  ggsave(plot = p, filename = str_c(p_filename, ".pdf"), height = height, width = width)
}
```

```{r ROE - Macrophage/Monocyte}
##============================================================================##
# Program: RO/E analysis for cell population preference

library(Startrac)

#---- Part 1. Load sce object
out_dir <- "11.5.Check_Cluster_anno"
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

sce <- readRDS("mac_mono_sce.Rds")
cell_type_order <- readRDS("celltype_lv2.order.Rds")
cell_type_colors <- readRDS("celltype_lv2.colors.Rds")

Idents(sce) <- "celltype_lv2"

#---- Part 2. Prepare data.frame for RO/E analysis
meta_data <- sce@meta.data

meta_data <- meta_data[, c("orig.ident", "tissue", "celltype_lv2")] %>%
  dplyr::mutate(clone.id = rownames(sce@meta.data))

data <- data.frame(
  clone.id = meta_data$clone.id,
  patient = meta_data$orig.ident,
  majorCluster = meta_data$celltype_lv2,
  loc = meta_data$tissue,
  Cell_Name = "MacMono cell"
)

data$patient <- as.character(data$patient)
data$clone.id <- as.character(data$clone.id)
data$majorCluster <- as.character(data$majorCluster)
data$loc <- as.character(data$loc)

#---- Part 3. Perform RO/E analysis
roe <- calTissueDist(
  data,
  byPatient = FALSE,
  colname.cluster = "majorCluster",
  colname.patient = "patient",
  colname.tissue = "loc",
  method = "chisq",
  min.rowSum = 0
)

roe_wide <- roe %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Var2, values_from = Freq)

#---- Part 4. Visualization and output
out_dir <- "13.1.MacMono-Roe"
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

writexl::write_xlsx(roe_wide, path = "roe_data_frame.xlsx")

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(min(roe, na.rm = TRUE), 1, max(roe, na.rm = TRUE)),
  c("#155F83FF", "white", "#A20056FF")
)

pdf(file = "roe_heatmap.pdf", width = 5.5, height = 5)
Heatmap(
  as.matrix(roe),
  show_heatmap_legend = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  row_names_side = "right",
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  col = col_fun,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Ro/e Index",
    at = seq(0.5, 1.5, by = 0.5),
    labels = seq(0.5, 1.5, by = 0.5)
  ),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    grid.text(sprintf("%.2f", roe[i, j]), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, col = "black"))
  }
)
dev.off()
```

```{r MiloR - Macrophage/Monocyte}
#---- Part 2. MiloR analysis
out_dir <- "13.2.MacMono-miloR"

# Convert Seurat object to SingleCellExperiment
sce_pre <- as.SingleCellExperiment(sce)

# Build Milo object
sce_milo <- Milo(sce_pre)
reducedDim(sce_milo, "TSNE") <- reducedDim(sce_pre, "TSNE")

# Build KNN graph
sce_milo <- buildGraph(sce_milo, k = 30, d = 15, reduced.dim = "PCA")

# Define representative neighbourhoods on the KNN graph
sce_milo <- makeNhoods(
  sce_milo,
  prop = 0.2,
  k = 30,
  d = 15,
  refined = TRUE,
  reduced_dims = "PCA"
)

p <- plotNhoodSizeHist(sce_milo)
fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(
  final_folder = out_dir,
  p_filename = "01.sce_milo-plotNhoodSizeHist",
  p = p,
  height = 4,
  width = 4
)

# Count cells per neighbourhood in each sample
sce_milo <- countCells(
  sce_milo,
  meta.data = as.data.frame(colData(sce_milo)),
  sample = "orig.ident"
)

# Experimental design
traj_design <- data.frame(colData(sce_milo))[, c("orig.ident", "tissue")]
traj_design <- distinct(traj_design)
rownames(traj_design) <- traj_design$orig.ident
traj_design <- traj_design[colnames(nhoodCounts(sce_milo)), , drop = FALSE]
traj_design$tissue <- factor(traj_design$tissue, levels = c("A", "P"))

# Compute neighbourhood connectivity
sce_milo <- calcNhoodDistance(sce_milo, d = 15, reduced.dim = "PCA")

# Differential abundance testing
da_results <- testNhoods(sce_milo, design = ~ tissue, design.df = traj_design)

# Summary plots
p2.1 <- ggplot(da_results, aes(PValue)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50)

p2.2 <- ggplot(da_results, aes(logFC, -log10(SpatialFDR))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1)

fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(
  final_folder = out_dir,
  p_filename = "02.sce_milo-da_results.Barplot",
  p = p2.1,
  height = 4,
  width = 4
)

fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(
  final_folder = out_dir,
  p_filename = "02.sce_milo-da_results.Dotplot",
  p = p2.2,
  height = 4,
  width = 4
)

#---- Part 3. Visualization and output
sce_milo <- buildNhoodGraph(sce_milo)

TSNE_pl <- plotReducedDim(
  sce_milo,
  dimred = "TSNE",
  colour_by = "tissue",
  text_by = "celltype_lv2",
  text_size = 3,
  point_size = 0.5
) + guides(fill = "none")

fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(
  final_folder = out_dir,
  p_filename = "03.sce_milo-plotReducedDim",
  p = TSNE_pl,
  height = 6,
  width = 6
)

nh_graph_pl <- plotNhoodGraphDA(
  sce_milo,
  da_results,
  layout = "TSNE",
  alpha = 0.9
)

fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(
  final_folder = out_dir,
  p_filename = "04.sce_milo-plotNhoodGraphDA.nh_graph_pl",
  p = nh_graph_pl,
  height = 6,
  width = 6
)

da_results <- annotateNhoods(sce_milo, da_results, coldata_col = "celltype_lv2")

p5 <- ggplot(da_results, aes(celltype_fraction)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50)

p6 <- plotDAbeeswarm(da_results, group.by = "celltype_lv2", alpha = 0.9)

fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(
  final_folder = out_dir,
  p_filename = "05.sce_milo-geom_histogram",
  p = p5,
  height = 6,
  width = 6
)

fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(
  final_folder = out_dir,
  p_filename = "06.sce_milo-plotDAbeeswarm",
  p = p6,
  height = 6,
  width = 6
)

#---- Identify DA neighbourhood markers
sce_milo <- logNormCounts(sce_milo)

da_results$NhoodGroup <- as.numeric(da_results$SpatialFDR < 0.9 & da_results$logFC < 0)

da_nhood_markers <- findNhoodGroupMarkers(
  sce_milo,
  da_results,
  subset.row = rownames(sce_milo),
  aggregate.samples = TRUE,
  sample_col = "orig.ident"
)

#---- 12.1 Automatic neighbourhood grouping
sce_milo <- buildNhoodGraph(sce_milo)

da_results <- groupNhoods(
  sce_milo,
  da_results,
  max.lfc.delta = 2,
  da.fdr = 0.9
)

p7 <- plotNhoodGroups(sce_milo, da_results, layout = "TSNE")
p8 <- plotDAbeeswarm(da_results, "NhoodGroup", alpha = 0.9)

fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(
  final_folder = out_dir,
  p_filename = "07.sce_milo-plotNhoodGroups",
  p = p7,
  height = 6,
  width = 6
)

fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(
  final_folder = out_dir,
  p_filename = "08.sce_milo-plotDAbeeswarm",
  p = p8,
  height = 6,
  width = 6
)

#---- 12.2 Find marker genes
keep.rows <- rowSums(logcounts(sce_milo)) != 0
sce_milo <- sce_milo[keep.rows, ]

dec <- modelGeneVar(sce_milo)
hvgs <- getTopHVGs(dec, n = 2000)

nhood_markers <- findNhoodGroupMarkers(
  sce_milo,
  da_results,
  subset.row = hvgs,
  aggregate.samples = TRUE,
  sample_col = "orig.ident"
)

# Marker genes for group 2
gr2_markers <- nhood_markers[, c("logFC_2", "adj.P.Val_2")]
colnames(gr2_markers) <- c("logFC", "adj.P.Val")

# Restrict analysis to a specific group
nhood_markers <- findNhoodGroupMarkers(
  sce_milo,
  da_results,
  subset.row = hvgs,
  aggregate.samples = TRUE,
  sample_col = "orig.ident",
  subset.groups = c("2")
)

# Restrict analysis to selected neighbourhood groups
nhood_markers <- findNhoodGroupMarkers(
  sce_milo,
  da_results,
  subset.row = hvgs,
  subset.nhoods = da_results$NhoodGroup %in% c("2", "5"),
  aggregate.samples = TRUE,
  sample_col = "orig.ident"
)

#---- 12.3 Differential gene visualization
p9 <- ggplot(nhood_markers, aes(logFC_2, -log10(adj.P.Val_2))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05)

markers <- nhood_markers$GeneID[
  nhood_markers$adj.P.Val_2 < 0.05 & nhood_markers$logFC_2 > 1
]

plotNhoodExpressionGroups(
  sce_milo,
  da_results,
  features = markers,
  subset.nhoods = da_results$NhoodGroup %in% c("2", "5"),
  scale = TRUE,
  grid.space = "fixed"
)

#---- 12.4 Differential expression within the same neighbourhood group
dge_3 <- testDiffExp(
  sce_milo,
  da_results,
  design = ~ tissue,
  meta.data = data.frame(colData(sce_milo)),
  subset.row = rownames(sce_milo),
  subset.nhoods = da_results$NhoodGroup == "3"
)

saveRDS(sce_milo, file = "sce_mile.Rds")
```

```{r Differential analysis and enrichment analysis of Macrophage/Monocyte subsets}
##===================================================================================##
# Program: Differential expression and enrichment analysis of A-vs-P in MonoMac subsets
##===================================================================================##

# Library and basic functions
setwd(file.path(root_path, code_folder, "lib"))
options(
  reticulate.conda_binary = "F:\\Anaconda3\\envs\\SCP_3.9",
  SCP_env_name = "SCP_3.9"
)

library(SCP)

fxx.col_palette.list <- list(
	kk = c("#FDDED7", "#F5BE8F", "#C1E0DB", "#CCD376", "#A28CC2", "#8498AB", "#5CB0C3"),
	vb = colors <- c("#8FB4DC", "#FFDD8E", "#70CDBE", "#AC99D2", "#7AC3DF", "#F5AA61", "#EB7E60"),
	ag = c("#458A74", "#018B38", "#D9A421", "#F5A216", "#57AF37", "#41B9C1", "#008B8B", 
                     "#4E5689", "#6A8EC9", "#652884", "#652884", "#8A7355", "#CC5B45", "#848484", 
                     "#E42320", "#B46DA9")
)

fxx.sanitize_variable_name <- function(input_string) {
  sanitized <- gsub("^[^a-zA-Z]", "_", input_string)  
  sanitized <- gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9_]", "_", sanitized)  
  
  print(paste("Sanitized variable name:", sanitized))
  
  return(sanitized)
}

library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)

fxx.seuratPreProcess <- function(obj, selectionMethod="vst", nFindVariableFeatures=2000, dims=1:10, res=0.5, seed=1){
  set.seed(seed)
  # perform standard Seurat preprocessing 
  # (Normalization, Scaling, Dimensionality Reduction, Clustering)
  obj <- NormalizeData(obj)
  obj <- ScaleData(obj, verbose=FALSE)
  obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, selection.method=selectionMethod, nfeatures=nFindVariableFeatures)
  obj <- RunPCA(obj)
  obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims=dims)
  obj <- RunTSNE(obj, dims=dims)
  obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims=dims)
  
  # FindCluster for every resolution
  for(r in res) {
    obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution=r, random.seed=seed)
  }
  
  return(obj)
}

# Import data
out_dir <- "11.5.Check_Cluster_anno"
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))
sce <- readRDS("mac_mono_sce.Rds")
cell_type_order <- readRDS("celltype_lv2.order.Rds")
cell_type_colors <- readRDS("celltype_lv2.colors.Rds")

# Output directory
out_dir <- "14.1.MacMono_subcluster.A-Vs-P"
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

# Part 1: Differential expression analysis by celltype_lv2
degs_list <- list()
celltypes <- unique(sce@meta.data$celltype_lv2)

for (celltype in celltypes) {
  sce_subset <- subset(sce, celltype_lv2 == celltype)
  Idents(sce_subset) <- sce_subset$tissue
  
  deg_results <- FindMarkers(
    sce_subset,
    ident.1 = "A",
    ident.2 = "P",
    min.pct = 0.1,
    logfc.threshold = 0.1,
    only.pos = TRUE
  )
  
  deg_results$gene <- rownames(deg_results)
  degs_list[[celltype]] <- deg_results
  
  setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))
  saveRDS(deg_results, paste0(celltype, "_A-Vs-P.Rds"))
  writexl::write_xlsx(deg_results, paste0(celltype, "_A-Vs-P.xlsx"))
}

saveRDS(degs_list, file = "degs_list.Rds")

# Part 2: Enrichment analysis for DEGs
degs_list <- readRDS("degs_list.Rds")
celltypes <- names(degs_list)

all_enrichment_results <- list()
out_dir <- "14.2.MacMono_subcluster.A-Vs-P.degs.enrich"
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

for (celltype in celltypes) {
  up_genes <- degs_list[[celltype]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene)
  
  if (length(up_genes) < 5) {
    next
  }
  
  enrichment_results <- fxx.run_enrichment_multibase.uniLine(
    genes = up_genes,
    species = "mouse",
    p_cutoff = 0.05,
    q_cutoff = 0.2
  )
  
  all_enrichment_results[[celltype]] <- enrichment_results$df_results
  saveRDS(enrichment_results, file = paste0("enrichment_results.(", celltype, ").Rds"))
  
  output_file <- paste0("enrichment_results.(", celltype, ").xlsx")
  wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  
  for (name in names(enrichment_results$df_results)) {
    if (!is.null(enrichment_results$df_results[[name]]) &&
        nrow(enrichment_results$df_results[[name]]) > 0) {
      sheet_name <- name
      openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
      openxlsx::writeData(
        wb,
        sheet = sheet_name,
        x = enrichment_results$df_results[[name]]
      )
      openxlsx::addFilter(
        wb,
        sheet_name,
        row = 1,
        cols = 1:ncol(enrichment_results$df_results[[name]])
      )
      openxlsx::freezePane(wb, sheet_name, firstRow = TRUE)
      openxlsx::setColWidths(
        wb,
        sheet_name,
        cols = 1:ncol(enrichment_results$df_results[[name]]),
        widths = "auto"
      )
    }
  }
  
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, output_file, overwrite = TRUE)
}

# Summary workbook
summary_wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
all_databases <- unique(unlist(lapply(all_enrichment_results, names)))

for (db in all_databases) {
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(summary_wb, db)
  summary_df <- data.frame()
  
  for (cluster_name in names(all_enrichment_results)) {
    if (db %in% names(all_enrichment_results[[cluster_name]]) &&
        !is.null(all_enrichment_results[[cluster_name]][[db]]) &&
        nrow(all_enrichment_results[[cluster_name]][[db]]) > 0) {
      
      curr_df <- all_enrichment_results[[cluster_name]][[db]] %>%
        dplyr::select(Description, p.adjust) %>%
        dplyr::rename(!!cluster_name := p.adjust)
      
      if (nrow(summary_df) == 0) {
        summary_df <- curr_df
      } else {
        summary_df <- dplyr::full_join(summary_df, curr_df, by = "Description")
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (nrow(summary_df) > 0) {
    if (ncol(summary_df) > 2) {
      summary_df <- summary_df[order(summary_df[[2]], na.last = TRUE), ]
    }
    
    openxlsx::writeData(summary_wb, db, x = summary_df)
    openxlsx::addFilter(summary_wb, db, row = 1, cols = 1:ncol(summary_df))
    openxlsx::freezePane(summary_wb, db, firstRow = TRUE)
    openxlsx::setColWidths(summary_wb, db, cols = 1:ncol(summary_df), widths = "auto")
  }
}

openxlsx::saveWorkbook(summary_wb, "02.enrichment_summary.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r Macrophage/Monocyte scMetabolism package metabolism activity scoring}
genesets_r <- read.gmt("REACTOME_metabolism.gmt")
gmt <- c(genesets_k, genesets_r)

data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(gmt), function(i) {
  name <- names(gmt[i])
  genes <- gmt[[i]]
  data.frame(term = name, gene = genes)
}))

data <- data %>% mutate(gene = str_to_title(gene))

})

  assay = "RNA",

  min.cells = 3,

  geneset = geneSets,
  geneid = "symbol",
  method = c("AUCell", "UCell"),
  aucell.MaxRank = NULL,

)

# Save results

saveRDS(sce, file = "01.macmono.sce(scmetabolism_assay).Rds")
```

```{r Macrophage/Monocyte scMetabolism package metabolism activity basd trendency analysis}
##============================================================================##
## Program: Differential analysis after scMetabolism scoring -> identify commonly altered pathways
##============================================================================##

names <- c(
  "Ly6c+Cx3cr1+_mono",
  "Ly6c+IFN_activated_mono",
  "Aif1+IFN_activated_mac",
  "Ccl5+M1like_mac"
)

method <- "AUCell"
down_list <- list()
up_list <- list()

for (name in names) {
  down <- result.dge.list[[name]][[method]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::filter(avg_diff < 0) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(celltype = name)

  up <- result.dge.list[[name]][[method]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::filter(avg_diff > 0) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(celltype = name)

  down_list[[name]] <- down
  up_list[[name]] <- up
}

down_paths_list <- lapply(down_list, function(df) df$Name)
common_down_paths <- Reduce(intersect, down_paths_list)
length(common_down_paths)

up_paths_list <- lapply(up_list, function(df) df$Name)
common_up_paths <- Reduce(intersect, up_paths_list)
length(common_up_paths)
```

```{r Visualization}
##============================================================================##
# Program: Differential analysis and visualization of a specific scMetabolism
# pathway in all Mono/Mac cells and selected celltype_lv2 subsets
##============================================================================##

#---- Part 1. Load pathway activity data
pathway_of_interest <- "Butanoate metabolism"

dat <- data.frame(t(sce@assays[["AUCell"]]@scale.data[pathway_of_interest, ]))
rownames(dat) <- pathway_of_interest

data <- t(dat)
rn <- rownames(data)
rn <- str_replace_all(rn, pattern = fixed("."), replacement = "-")
rownames(data) <- rn

meta_data <- data.frame(sce@meta.data)
common_rows <- intersect(rownames(meta_data), rownames(data))
data <- data[common_rows, ]
meta_data <- meta_data[common_rows, ]

data_meta_exp <- cbind(data, meta_data)
colnames(data_meta_exp)[1] <- "exp"

#---- Part 2. Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(gghalves)
library(ggridges)
library(cols4all)

#---- Part 3. Colors
mycol1 <- c("#00264D", "#F2B701")
mycol2 <- c("#003366", "#800020")

#---- Part 4. Visualization for all Mono/Mac cells
pathway_data <- data.frame(
  Expression = data_meta_exp[, "exp"],
  tissue = data_meta_exp$tissue
)

my_comparisons <- list(c("P", "A"))

p1 <- ggplot(data = pathway_data, aes(x = tissue, y = Expression, fill = tissue, color = tissue)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mycol1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mycol1) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", hide.ns = FALSE, comparisons = my_comparisons, label = "p.signif") +
  labs(title = pathway_of_interest)

p2 <- p1 + stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", size = 3)

p3 <- p1 + geom_point(position = "jitter", size = 0.5, alpha = 0.3)

p4 <- ggplot(data = pathway_data, aes(x = tissue, y = Expression)) +
  geom_point(position = "jitter", color = "grey", size = 0.5, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = tissue), color = "grey", alpha = 0.8, scale = "width", linewidth = 0.6, trim = TRUE) +
  geom_boxplot(color = "white", outlier.color = "black", width = 0.4, size = 0.8, fill = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mycol1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mycol1) +
  theme_classic() +
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", hide.ns = FALSE, comparisons = my_comparisons, label = "p.signif") +
  labs(title = pathway_of_interest)

p5 <- ggplot(data = pathway_data, aes(x = Expression, y = tissue, fill = tissue)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.8, color = "white", rel_min_height = 0.01, scale = 1.8, quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mycol2) +
  theme_classic() +
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", hide.ns = FALSE, comparisons = my_comparisons, label = "p.signif") +
  labs(title = pathway_of_interest)

p6 <- ggplot(data = pathway_data, aes(x = Expression, y = tissue, fill = tissue)) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    alpha = 0.8, color = "#EEEEEE", rel_min_height = 0.01, scale = 1.8,
    quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = 2, jittered_points = TRUE,
    point_shape = "|", point_size = 5, position = position_points_jitter(height = 0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mycol2) +
  theme_classic() +
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", hide.ns = FALSE, comparisons = my_comparisons, label = "p.signif") +
  labs(title = pathway_of_interest)

p7 <- ggplot(data = pathway_data, aes(x = tissue, y = Expression, fill = tissue, color = tissue)) +
  geom_half_violin(side = "R", alpha = 0.6, position = position_nudge(x = 0.1, y = 0)) +
  geom_half_boxplot(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_half_point(alpha = 0.2, side = "L", position = position_nudge(x = -0.15, y = 0)) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mycol2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mycol2) +
  coord_flip() +
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", hide.ns = FALSE, comparisons = my_comparisons, label = "p.signif") +
  labs(title = pathway_of_interest)

#---- Part 5. Save plots for all Mono/Mac cells
out_dir <- file.path("15.2.scMetabolism_visual", pathway_of_interest, "all_MonoMac")
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, paste0("Expression_p1_", pathway_of_interest), p = p1, height = 3.5, width = 3)
fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, paste0("Expression_p2_", pathway_of_interest), p = p2, height = 3.5, width = 3)
fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, paste0("Expression_p3_", pathway_of_interest), p = p3, height = 3.5, width = 3)
fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, paste0("Expression_p4_", pathway_of_interest), p = p4, height = 3.5, width = 3)
fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, paste0("Expression_p5_", pathway_of_interest), p = p5, height = 2.5, width = 4)
fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, paste0("Expression_p6_", pathway_of_interest), p = p6, height = 2.5, width = 4)
fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, paste0("Expression_p7_", pathway_of_interest), p = p7, height = 2.5, width = 4.5)

##============================================================================##
# Program: Differential analysis and visualization of a specific scMetabolism
# pathway in selected celltype_lv2 subsets of Mono/Mac cells
##============================================================================##

#---- Part 6. Colors and target cell types
mycol1 <- c("#00264D", "#F2B701")
mycol2 <- c("#003366", "#800020")

celltypes_to_analyze <- c(
  "Ly6c+Cx3cr1+_mono",
  "Ly6c+IFN_activated_mono",
  "Aif1+IFN_activated_mac",
  "Ccl5+M1like_mac"
)

#---- Part 7. Visualization function
fxx.pathway_visualization <- function(pathway_of_interest, celltype, data_meta_exp) {
  pathway_data <- data.frame(
    Expression = data_meta_exp[, "exp"],
    tissue = data_meta_exp$tissue
  )

  my_comparisons <- list(c("P", "A"))

  p1 <- ggplot(data = pathway_data, aes(x = tissue, y = Expression, fill = tissue, color = tissue)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.6) +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mycol1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = mycol1) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", hide.ns = FALSE, comparisons = my_comparisons, label = "p.signif") +
    labs(title = paste(pathway_of_interest, "\n", celltype))

  p2 <- p1 + stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", size = 3)

  p3 <- p1 + geom_point(position = "jitter", size = 0.5, alpha = 0.3)

  p4 <- ggplot(data = pathway_data, aes(x = tissue, y = Expression)) +
    geom_point(position = "jitter", color = "grey", size = 0.5, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = tissue), color = "grey", alpha = 0.8, scale = "width", linewidth = 0.6, trim = TRUE) +
    geom_boxplot(color = "white", outlier.color = "black", width = 0.4, size = 0.8, fill = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mycol1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = mycol1) +
    theme_classic() +
    stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", hide.ns = FALSE, comparisons = my_comparisons, label = "p.signif") +
    labs(title = paste(pathway_of_interest, "\n", celltype))

  p5 <- ggplot(data = pathway_data, aes(x = Expression, y = tissue, fill = tissue)) +
    geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.8, color = "white", rel_min_height = 0.01, scale = 1.8, quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mycol2) +
    theme_classic() +
    stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", hide.ns = FALSE, comparisons = my_comparisons, label = "p.signif") +
    labs(title = paste(pathway_of_interest, "\n", celltype))

  p6 <- ggplot(data = pathway_data, aes(x = Expression, y = tissue, fill = tissue)) +
    geom_density_ridges(
      alpha = 0.8, color = "#EEEEEE", rel_min_height = 0.01, scale = 1.8,
      quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = 2, jittered_points = TRUE,
      point_shape = "|", point_size = 5, position = position_points_jitter(height = 0)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mycol2) +
    theme_classic() +
    stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", hide.ns = FALSE, comparisons = my_comparisons, label = "p.signif") +
    labs(title = paste(pathway_of_interest, "\n", celltype))

  p7 <- ggplot(data = pathway_data, aes(x = tissue, y = Expression, fill = tissue, color = tissue)) +
    geom_half_violin(side = "R", alpha = 0.6, position = position_nudge(x = 0.1, y = 0)) +
    geom_half_boxplot(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_half_point(alpha = 0.2, side = "L", position = position_nudge(x = -0.15, y = 0)) +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mycol2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = mycol2) +
    coord_flip() +
    stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", hide.ns = FALSE, comparisons = my_comparisons, label = "p.signif") +
    labs(title = paste(pathway_of_interest, "\n", celltype))

  return(list(p1 = p1, p2 = p2, p3 = p3, p4 = p4, p5 = p5, p6 = p6, p7 = p7))
}

#---- Part 8. Rebuild data for subset analysis
dat <- data.frame(t(sce@assays[["AUCell"]]@scale.data[pathway_of_interest, ]))
rownames(dat) <- pathway_of_interest

data <- t(dat)
rn <- rownames(data)
rn <- str_replace_all(rn, pattern = fixed("."), replacement = "-")
rownames(data) <- rn

meta_data <- data.frame(sce@meta.data)
common_rows <- intersect(rownames(meta_data), rownames(data))
data <- data[common_rows, ]
meta_data <- meta_data[common_rows, ]

data_meta_exp <- cbind(data, meta_data)
colnames(data_meta_exp)[1] <- "exp"

#---- Part 9. Loop through selected cell types
for (celltype in celltypes_to_analyze) {
  celltype_data <- data_meta_exp[data_meta_exp$celltype_lv2 == celltype, ]

  if (nrow(celltype_data) > 0) {
    plots <- fxx.pathway_visualization(pathway_of_interest, celltype, celltype_data)

    out_dir <- file.path("15.2.scMetabolism_visual", pathway_of_interest, celltype)
    setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

    fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, paste0("Expression_p1_", pathway_of_interest), p = plots$p1, height = 3.5, width = 3)
    fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, paste0("Expression_p2_", pathway_of_interest), p = plots$p2, height = 3.5, width = 3)
    fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, paste0("Expression_p3_", pathway_of_interest), p = plots$p3, height = 3.5, width = 3)
    fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, paste0("Expression_p4_", pathway_of_interest), p = plots$p4, height = 3.5, width = 3)
    fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, paste0("Expression_p5_", pathway_of_interest), p = plots$p5, height = 2.5, width = 4)
    fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, paste0("Expression_p6_", pathway_of_interest), p = plots$p6, height = 2.5, width = 4)
    fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, paste0("Expression_p7_", pathway_of_interest), p = plots$p7, height = 2.5, width = 4.5)
  } else {
    warning(paste("No data available for cell type:", celltype))
  }
}
```

```{r Macrophage/Monocyte Monocle3}
           label_groups_by_cluster=F,
           label_leaves=F,
           label_roots = F,

           label_branch_points=F,

plot_cells(Cds,
           reduction_method = "UMAP",
           label_groups_by_cluster=F,
           label_leaves=F,
           label_roots = T,
           cell_size = 1,

           color_cells_by = "celltype_lv2")+
```

```{r Slingshot function}
fxx.slingshot.plot_trajectory_with_arrows <- function(
  sce_obj,
  reduction = "TSNE",
  cell_colors = NULL,
  arrow_length = 0.15,
  arrow_angle = 30,
  line_width = 2.2
) {
  plot(
    reducedDims(sce_obj)[[reduction]],
    col = cell_colors,
    pch = 16,
    asp = 1,
    cex = 0.8,
    main = paste(reduction, "with Trajectory Direction")
  )

  sds <- SlingshotDataSet(sce_obj)
  curves <- slingCurves(sds)

  for (i in seq_along(curves)) {
    curve_points <- curves[[i]]$s[curves[[i]]$ord, ]
    lines(curve_points, lwd = line_width, col = "black")

    n_points <- nrow(curve_points)
    if (n_points >= 2) {
      p1 <- curve_points[n_points - 1, ]
      p2 <- curve_points[n_points, ]

      arrows(
        p1[1], p1[2], p2[1], p2[2],
        length = arrow_length,
        angle = arrow_angle,
        code = 2,
        lwd = line_width,
        col = "black"
      )
    }
  }
}

# Pseudotime density plot for all valid cell types
fxx.slingshot.plot_pseudotime_density <- function(
  sce_obj,
  trajectory_number = 1,
  cell_type_column = "celltype_lv2",
  custom_colors = NULL,
  legend_position = "right",
  alpha = 0.5,
  cex.legend = 0.8,
  main = NULL
) {
  pseudotime_data <- slingPseudotime(sce_obj)
  cell_types <- colData(sce_obj)[[cell_type_column]]
  unique_cell_types <- unique(cell_types)

  valid_cell_types <- c()
  for (ct in unique_cell_types) {
    ct_pseudotime <- pseudotime_data[cell_types == ct, trajectory_number]
    if (sum(!is.na(ct_pseudotime)) > 0) {
      valid_cell_types <- c(valid_cell_types, ct)
    }
  }

  density_list <- list()
  for (i in seq_along(valid_cell_types)) {
    ct <- valid_cell_types[i]
    ct_pseudotime <- pseudotime_data[cell_types == ct, trajectory_number]
    density_list[[ct]] <- density(ct_pseudotime, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  all_x <- unlist(lapply(density_list, function(d) d$x))
  all_y <- unlist(lapply(density_list, function(d) d$y))
  xlim <- range(all_x, na.rm = TRUE)
  ylim <- range(all_y, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (is.null(custom_colors)) {
    num_colors <- length(valid_cell_types)
    colors <- brewer.pal(min(num_colors, 8), "Set1")
    if (num_colors > 8) {
      colors <- colorRampPalette(colors)(num_colors)
    }
    plot_colors <- setNames(colors, valid_cell_types)
  } else {
    plot_colors <- custom_colors[valid_cell_types]
  }

  transparent_colors <- sapply(plot_colors, function(x) adjustcolor(x, alpha.f = alpha))

  if (legend_position == "right") {
    par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 10), xpd = TRUE)
  } else if (legend_position == "left") {
    par(mar = c(5, 10, 4, 4), xpd = TRUE)
  } else if (legend_position == "top") {
    par(mar = c(5, 4, 8, 4), xpd = TRUE)
  } else if (legend_position == "bottom") {
    par(mar = c(10, 4, 4, 4), xpd = TRUE)
  }

  if (is.null(main)) {
    main <- paste("Trajectory", trajectory_number, "Pseudotime Distribution")
  }

  plot(xlim, ylim, col = "white", xlab = "Pseudotime", ylab = "Density", main = main)

  for (i in seq_along(valid_cell_types)) {
    ct <- valid_cell_types[i]
    d <- density_list[[ct]]
    polygon(
      c(min(d$x), d$x, max(d$x)),
      c(0, d$y, 0),
      col = transparent_colors[i],
      border = NA
    )
  }

  return(list(
    density_list = density_list,
    valid_cell_types = valid_cell_types,
    colors = plot_colors
  ))
}

# Plot pseudotime distribution on a 2D embedding
#'
#' @param sce_obj A SingleCellExperiment object containing Slingshot results
#' @param trajectory_number Trajectory index to visualize
#' @param reduction_name Dimensionality reduction name, e.g. "TSNE" or "UMAP"
#' @param file_name Output PDF file name without extension
#' @param width PDF width
#' @param height PDF height
#' @param reverse_colors Whether to reverse the color scale
#' @param point_size Point size
#' @param alpha Point transparency
#' @param title Plot title
#' @param color_scheme Color scheme, either "default" or a custom color vector
#'
#' @return Invisibly returns a list with trajectory summary information
#'
fxx.slingshot.plot_pseudotime_distribution <- function(
  sce_obj,
  trajectory_number = 1,
  reduction_name = "TSNE",
  file_name = "pseudotime_distribution",
  width = 8,
  height = 8,
  reverse_colors = FALSE,
  point_size = 0.9,
  alpha = 0.7,
  title = "Cell Pseudotime Distribution",
  color_scheme = "default"
) {
  pseudotime_col <- paste0("slingPseudotime_", trajectory_number)

  if (!pseudotime_col %in% colnames(colData(sce_obj))) {
    stop(paste("Pseudotime column not found:", pseudotime_col))
  }

  pseudotime_values <- sce_obj[[pseudotime_col]]
  has_pseudotime <- !is.na(pseudotime_values)
  pt_values <- pseudotime_values[has_pseudotime]
  cells_with_pt <- which(has_pseudotime)

  if (length(pt_values) == 0) {
    stop("No valid pseudotime values found.")
  }

  if (!reduction_name %in% names(reducedDims(sce_obj))) {
    stop(paste("Reduction not found:", reduction_name))
  }

  if (color_scheme == "default") {
    if (reverse_colors) {
      gradient_colors <- colorRampPalette(
        c("#E64B35", "#FF7F00", "#FFEDA0", "#91BFDB", "#4575B4")
      )(100)
    } else {
      gradient_colors <- colorRampPalette(
        c("#4575B4", "#91BFDB", "#FFEDA0", "#FF7F00", "#E64B35")
      )(100)
    }
  } else {
    gradient_colors <- colorRampPalette(color_scheme)(100)
  }

  normalized_pt <- (pt_values - min(pt_values)) / (max(pt_values) - min(pt_values))
  color_indices <- ceiling(normalized_pt * 100)
  color_indices[color_indices < 1] <- 1
  color_indices[color_indices > 100] <- 100

  cell_colors <- rep("#F0F0F0", length(pseudotime_values))
  cell_colors[cells_with_pt] <- gradient_colors[color_indices]
  transparent_colors <- sapply(cell_colors, function(x) adjustcolor(x, alpha.f = alpha))

  pdf(paste0(file_name, ".pdf"), width = width, height = height)
  par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 8), xpd = TRUE)

  plot(
    reducedDims(sce_obj)[[reduction_name]],
    col = transparent_colors,
    pch = 16,
    cex = point_size,
    asp = 1,
    main = title,
    xlab = paste0(reduction_name, "_1"),
    ylab = paste0(reduction_name, "_2")
  )

  gradient_legend_x <- par("usr")[2] + (par("usr")[2] - par("usr")[1]) * 0.03
  gradient_legend_y_top <- par("usr")[4] - (par("usr")[4] - par("usr")[3]) * 0.1
  gradient_legend_height <- (par("usr")[4] - par("usr")[3]) * 0.5

  gradient_steps <- 20
  for (i in 1:gradient_steps) {
    y_bottom <- gradient_legend_y_top - i / gradient_steps * gradient_legend_height
    y_top <- gradient_legend_y_top - (i - 1) / gradient_steps * gradient_legend_height
    rect(
      gradient_legend_x,
      y_bottom,
      gradient_legend_x + (par("usr")[2] - par("usr")[1]) * 0.02,
      y_top,
      col = gradient_colors[ceiling(i * 100 / gradient_steps)],
      border = NA
    )
  }

  text(
    gradient_legend_x + (par("usr")[2] - par("usr")[1]) * 0.03,
    gradient_legend_y_top + (par("usr")[4] - par("usr")[3]) * 0.05,
    "Pseudotime",
    adj = 0,
    cex = 0.9
  )

  if (!reverse_colors) {
    early_pos <- gradient_legend_y_top - gradient_legend_height * 0.05
    late_pos <- gradient_legend_y_top - gradient_legend_height * 0.95
  } else {
    early_pos <- gradient_legend_y_top - gradient_legend_height * 0.95
    late_pos <- gradient_legend_y_top - gradient_legend_height * 0.05
  }

  text(
    gradient_legend_x + (par("usr")[2] - par("usr")[1]) * 0.03,
    early_pos,
    "Early",
    adj = 0,
    cex = 0.8
  )

  text(
    gradient_legend_x + (par("usr")[2] - par("usr")[1]) * 0.03,
    late_pos,
    "Late",
    adj = 0,
    cex = 0.8
  )

  dev.off()

  invisible(list(
    trajectory = trajectory_number,
    cells_in_trajectory = sum(has_pseudotime),
    pseudotime_range = range(pt_values)
  ))
}


# Build matrix for pseudotime-dependent gene heatmap
#'
#' @param seurat_obj A Seurat object with pseudotime metadata and NA values removed
#' @param n_bins Number of pseudotime bins
#' @param min_exp Minimum expression deviation threshold for filtering genes
#'
#' @return A matrix for heatmap visualization
#'
fxx.slingshot_for_plotMatrix <- function(
  seurat_obj,
  n_bins,
  min_exp
) {
  seurat_meta <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  seurat_meta <- as_tibble(cbind(cell.id = as.character(rownames(seurat_meta)), seurat_meta))
  seurat_meta <- seurat_meta[order(seurat_meta$sling_pseudotime), ]

  pl_cells <- as.character(seurat_meta$cell.id)

  exp <- seurat_obj@assays$RNA@data
  exp <- exp[, colnames(exp) %in% pl_cells]
  expr_mat <- exp[, order(match(colnames(exp), pl_cells))]
  expr_mat <- as.matrix(expr_mat[rownames(expr_mat) %in% association_test_tab$gene, ])

  clust_expr_mat <- matrix(
    nrow = nrow(expr_mat),
    ncol = n_bins,
    dimnames = list(rownames(expr_mat), 1:n_bins)
  )

  max_pseudotime <- max(seurat_meta$sling_pseudotime)
  pseudotime_bin_size <- max_pseudotime / n_bins
  pseudotime_cluster_stat <- NULL

  seurat_obj@meta.data$pseudotime_bin <- NA_integer_

  for (i in 1:n_bins) {
    bin_cells <- seurat_meta$cell.id[
      seurat_meta$sling_pseudotime > (i - 1) * pseudotime_bin_size &
        seurat_meta$sling_pseudotime <= i * pseudotime_bin_size
    ]

    seurat_obj@meta.data$pseudotime_bin[colnames(seurat_obj) %in% bin_cells] <- i

    if (length(bin_cells) > 10) {
      m2 <- expr_mat[, colnames(expr_mat) %in% bin_cells]
      clust_expr_mat[, i] <- apply(m2, 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }

  mm1 <- clust_expr_mat - apply(clust_expr_mat, 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  mm2 <- mm1[apply(abs(mm1), 1, max, na.rm = TRUE) > min_exp, ]

  return(mm2)
}


# Draw heatmap for pseudotime-dependent genes
#'
#' @param matrix_data Input matrix for heatmap
#' @param file_name Output file name without extension
#' @param output_format Output format: "pdf", "png", or "both"
#' @param width Plot width
#' @param height Plot height
#' @param dpi PNG resolution
#' @param color_palette Color palette
#' @param show_rownames Whether to show row names
#' @param cluster_rows Whether to cluster rows
#' @param cluster_cols Whether to cluster columns
#' @param show_colnames Whether to show column names
#' @param clustering_distance_rows Distance metric for row clustering
#' @param clustering_method Clustering method
#' @param treeheight_row Row tree height
#' @param cutree_rows Number of row clusters
#' @param break_range Optional value range for color breaks
#' @param show_cluster_bar Whether to show row cluster annotation
#' @param cluster_colors Optional custom cluster colors
#'
#' @return A pheatmap object
#'
fxx.create_custom_heatmap <- function(
  matrix_data,
  file_name = "heatmap",
  output_format = "both",
  width = 8,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 600,
  color_palette = colorRampPalette(c("#3C5488", "#F0F0F0", "#E64B35"))(250),
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  treeheight_row = 50,
  cutree_rows = 5,
  break_range = NULL,
  show_cluster_bar = TRUE,
  cluster_colors = NULL
) {
  if (!requireNamespace("pheatmap", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'pheatmap' is required. Please install it.")
  }

  if (is.null(break_range)) {
    lim <- c(min(matrix_data, na.rm = TRUE), max(matrix_data, na.rm = TRUE))
    color_count <- length(color_palette)
    breaks <- seq(lim[1], lim[2], length.out = color_count + 1)
  } else {
    color_count <- length(color_palette)
    breaks <- seq(break_range[1], break_range[2], length.out = color_count + 1)
  }

  if (show_cluster_bar && cluster_rows) {
    dist_matrix <- dist(matrix_data, method = clustering_distance_rows)
    hclust_result <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = clustering_method)
    clusters <- cutree(hclust_result, k = cutree_rows)

    row_annotation <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(clusters))

    if (is.null(cluster_colors)) {
      modern_palette <- c(
        "#E64B35FF", "#4DBBD5FF", "#00A087FF", "#3C5488FF", "#F39B7FFF",
        "#8491B4FF", "#91D1C2FF", "#DC0000FF", "#7E6148FF", "#B09C85FF",
        "#FF6F00FF", "#C71000FF", "#008EA0FF", "#8A4198FF", "#5A9599FF",
        "#FF6348FF", "#84D7E1FF", "#FF95A8FF", "#3F8F57FF", "#6A6599FF"
      )

      if (cutree_rows <= length(modern_palette)) {
        cluster_palette <- modern_palette[1:cutree_rows]
      } else {
        cluster_palette <- colorRampPalette(modern_palette)(cutree_rows)
      }

      cluster_colors <- list(Cluster = setNames(
        cluster_palette,
        levels(factor(clusters))
      ))
    }

    names(row_annotation) <- "Cluster"
  } else {
    row_annotation <- NULL
    cluster_colors <- NULL
  }

  create_heatmap <- function() {
    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      matrix_data,
      annotation_row = row_annotation,
      annotation_colors = cluster_colors,
      show_rownames = show_rownames,
      cluster_rows = cluster_rows,
      cluster_cols = cluster_cols,
      show_colnames = show_colnames,
      clustering_distance_rows = clustering_distance_rows,
      clustering_method = clustering_method,
      treeheight_row = treeheight_row,
      cutree_rows = cutree_rows,
      color = color_palette,
      breaks = breaks,
      border_color = NA
    )
  }

  if (output_format == "pdf" || output_format == "both") {
    pdf_file <- paste0(file_name, ".pdf")
    pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height)
    heatmap_result <- create_heatmap()
    dev.off()
  }

  if (output_format == "png" || output_format == "both") {
    png_file <- paste0(file_name, ".png")
    png(png_file, width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = dpi)
    heatmap_result <- create_heatmap()
    dev.off()
  }

  return(create_heatmap())
}

# Plot cell density along pseudotime for time-dependent gene expression heatmaps
fxx.slingshot.plot_pseudotime_density <- function(
    sce_slingshot,
    group_column = "celltype",
    trajectory_number = 1,
    file_name = NULL,
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    margin = c(5, 5, 4, 15),
    legend_position = "topright",
    legend_inset = 0.5,
    legend_title = NULL,
    legend_cex = 0.8,
    custom_colors = NULL,
    alpha = 0.6,
    xlab = "Pseudotime",
    ylab = "",
    include_cell_counts = TRUE,
    max_groups = Inf
) {
  pseudotime_values <- slingPseudotime(sce_slingshot)[, trajectory_number]

  if (!group_column %in% colnames(colData(sce_slingshot))) {
    stop(paste("Column", group_column, "not found."))
  }

  group_var <- colData(sce_slingshot)[[group_column]]
  unique_groups <- unique(group_var)

  if (length(unique_groups) > max_groups) {
    warning(
      paste(
        "Found", length(unique_groups),
        "groups, which exceeds the maximum of", max_groups,
        "Only plotting the first", max_groups, "groups."
      )
    )
    unique_groups <- unique_groups[1:max_groups]
  }

  density_list <- list()
  valid_groups <- character(0)

  for (i in seq_along(unique_groups)) {
    group <- unique_groups[i]
    pt_values <- pseudotime_values[group_var == group]
    pt_values <- pt_values[!is.na(pt_values)]

    if (length(pt_values) >= 3) {
      density_list[[length(density_list) + 1]] <- density(pt_values, na.rm = TRUE)
      valid_groups <- c(valid_groups, as.character(group))
    }
  }

  if (length(density_list) == 0) {
    stop("No groups with sufficient pseudotime data points found.")
  }

  x_values <- unlist(lapply(density_list, function(d) d$x))
  y_values <- unlist(lapply(density_list, function(d) d$y))
  xlim <- range(x_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  ylim <- range(y_values, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (!is.null(custom_colors)) {
    if (!all(valid_groups %in% names(custom_colors))) {
      missing_groups <- valid_groups[!valid_groups %in% names(custom_colors)]
      warning(
        paste(
          "Custom colors not provided for groups:",
          paste(missing_groups, collapse = ", ")
        )
      )
    }

    color_palette <- custom_colors[valid_groups]

    if (any(is.na(color_palette))) {
      default_palette <- rainbow(length(valid_groups))
      color_palette[is.na(color_palette)] <- default_palette[is.na(color_palette)]
    }
  } else {
    if (requireNamespace("RColorBrewer", quietly = TRUE)) {
      if (length(valid_groups) <= 9) {
        color_palette <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(
          max(3, length(valid_groups)), "Set1"
        )[1:length(valid_groups)]
      } else {
        color_palette <- colorRampPalette(
          RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Set1")
        )(length(valid_groups))
      }
    } else {
      color_palette <- rainbow(length(valid_groups))
    }
  }

  if (requireNamespace("scales", quietly = TRUE)) {
    colors_with_alpha <- scales::alpha(color_palette, alpha)
  } else {
    rgb_cols <- col2rgb(color_palette) / 255
    colors_with_alpha <- rgb(rgb_cols[1, ], rgb_cols[2, ], rgb_cols[3, ], alpha)
  }

  if (include_cell_counts) {
    cell_counts <- sapply(valid_groups, function(g) {
      sum(group_var == g & !is.na(pseudotime_values))
    })
    legend_labels <- paste0(valid_groups, " (n=", cell_counts, ")")
  } else {
    legend_labels <- valid_groups
  }

  if (is.null(legend_title)) {
    legend_title <- group_column
  }

  if (!is.null(file_name)) {
    pdf(paste0(file_name, ".pdf"), width = width, height = height)
  }

  par(mar = margin, xpd = TRUE)
  plot(xlim, ylim, col = "white", xlab = xlab, ylab = ylab, type = "n")

  for (i in seq_along(density_list)) {
    d <- density_list[[i]]
    polygon(
      c(min(d$x), d$x, max(d$x)),
      c(0, d$y, 0),
      col = colors_with_alpha[i]
    )
  }

  legend(
    legend_position,
    inset = legend_inset,
    pch = 15,
    legend = legend_labels,
    bty = "n",
    col = color_palette,
    border = "black",
    title = legend_title,
    cex = legend_cex
  )

  if (!is.null(file_name)) {
    dev.off()
  }

  invisible(list(
    density_list = density_list,
    groups = valid_groups,
    colors = color_palette
  ))
}

# Example
# fxx.slingshot.plot_pseudotime_density(
```

```{r Trend analysis of metabolic activity over pseudotime inferred by Slingshot}
  if (is.numeric(cell_vars)) {
    pal <- pal_fun(100, ...)
    return(pal[cut(cell_vars, breaks = 100)])
  } else {
    categories <- sort(unique(cell_vars))
    pal <- setNames(pal_fun(length(categories), ...), categories)
    return(pal[cell_vars])
  }
```
