```{r Visualization of the Slingshot-inferred pseudotime trajectory}
##============================================================================##
# Program

sce_slinghot <- sce_slingshot_list$sce_slingshot_1

#---- Gene expression changes along pseudotime
pseudotimeED <- slingPseudotime(sce_slinghot, na = FALSE)
cellWeightsED <- slingCurveWeights(sce_slinghot)
counts <- sce_slinghot@assays@data@listData$counts

# Fit negative binomial GAM and evaluate the number of knots
icMat <- evaluateK(
  counts = counts,
  sds = sce_slinghot,
  nGenes = 50,
  k = 3:10,
  verbose = TRUE,
  plot = TRUE
)

sce_slinghot <- fitGAM(
  counts = counts,
  pseudotime = pseudotimeED,
  cellWeights = cellWeightsED,
  nknots = 5,
  verbose = TRUE,
  BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(20),
  parallel = TRUE
)

# Genes significantly associated with pseudotime
rowData(sce_slinghot)$assocRes <- associationTest(
  sce_slinghot,
  lineages = TRUE,
  l2fc = log2(2)
)
assocRes <- rowData(sce_slinghot)$assocRes
oAsso <- order(assocRes$waldStat, decreasing = TRUE)
Geneasso <- names(sce_slinghot)[oAsso[1]]

Geneasso <- "Lyz1"
plotSmoothers(
  sce_slinghot,
  assays(sce_slinghot)$counts,
  gene = Geneasso,
  alpha = 0.6,
  border = TRUE,
  lwd = 2
) + ggtitle(Geneasso)

# Within-lineage comparison
startRes <- startVsEndTest(sce_slinghot, lineages = TRUE)
oStart <- order(startRes$waldStat, decreasing = TRUE)
sigGeneStart <- names(sce_slinghot)[oStart[1]]

plotSmoothers(
  sce_slinghot,
  assays(sce_slinghot)$counts,
  gene = sigGeneStart
) + ggtitle(sigGeneStart)

plotGeneCount(
  sce_slinghot,
  assays(sce_slinghot)$counts,
  gene = sigGeneStart
) + ggtitle(sigGeneStart)

# Between-lineage comparison
endRes <- diffEndTest(sce_slinghot, pairwise = TRUE)
oEnd <- order(endRes$waldStat, decreasing = TRUE)
sigGene <- names(sce_slinghot)[oEnd[1]]

plotSmoothers(
  sce_slinghot,
  assays(sce_slinghot)$counts,
  gene = sigGene
) + ggtitle(sigGene)

plotGeneCount(
  sce_slinghot,
  assays(sce_slinghot)$counts,
  gene = sigGene
) + ggtitle(sigGene)

#---- Pathway activity changes along pseudotime
library(AUCell)
library(clusterProfiler)

cells_rankings <- AUCell_buildRankings(Mono@assays$RNA@data)
Hallmarker <- read.gmt("h.all.v2023.1.Hs.symbols.gmt")

geneSets <- lapply(
  unique(Hallmarker$term),
  function(x) Hallmarker$gene[Hallmarker$term == x]
)
names(geneSets) <- unique(Hallmarker$term)

cells_AUC <- AUCell_calcAUC(
  geneSets,
  cells_rankings,
  aucMaxRank = nrow(cells_rankings) * 0.1
)
sc_AUC <- getAUC(cells_AUC)

sce_slinghot <- fitGAM(
  counts = sc_AUC,
  pseudotime = pseudotimeED,
  cellWeights = cellWeightsED,
  nknots = 5,
  verbose = TRUE,
  BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(20),
  parallel = TRUE
)

plotSmoothers(
  sce_slinghot,
  assays(sce_slinghot)$counts,
  gene = "HALLMARK_HYPOXIA",
  alpha = 0.6,
  border = TRUE,
  lwd = 2
)

##============================================================================##
# Program: Test pseudotime-dependent gene expression
##============================================================================##
pseudotime_df <- data.frame(pseudotime = pseudotimeED[, 1])
exp_df <- data.frame(exp = sce@assays$RNA@counts["Lyz1", ])
exp_df <- exp_df[rownames(pseudotime_df), , drop = FALSE]
df <- cbind(pseudotime_df, exp_df)

# Log-transform expression values
df$exp_transformed <- log1p(df$exp)

# Fit GAM model and extract p-value
library(ggplot2)
library(mgcv)

gam_model <- gam(exp_transformed ~ s(pseudotime), data = df, method = "REML")
model_summary <- summary(gam_model)
pvalue <- model_summary$s.table[, "p-value"]
significance <- ifelse(
  pvalue < 0.001, "***",
  ifelse(pvalue < 0.01, "**",
         ifelse(pvalue < 0.05, "*", "ns"))
)

# Visualization
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = pseudotime, y = exp_transformed)) +
  geom_point(size = 2 / 3, alpha = 0.7, color = "#455A64") +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "gam",
    formula = y ~ s(x),
    se = TRUE,
    color = "#AA152564",
    size = 1.5,
    fill = "lightblue",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Pseudotime",
    y = "Log(expression + 1)",
    title = "Gene Expression over Pseudotime",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Time dependency p-value: ",
      format(pvalue, digits = 3),
      " ",
      significance
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic()

print(p)
```

```{r Marophage/Monocyte - Macrophage/Monocyte cellchat}
#------------------------#
library(CellChat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(NMF)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(reshape2)
library(dplyr)

# Set working directory and import data
out_dir <- "11.5.Check_Cluster_anno"
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))
sce <- readRDS("mac_mono_sce.Rds")
cell_type_order <- readRDS("celltype_lv2.order.Rds")
cell_type_colors <- readRDS("celltype_lv2.colors.Rds")

# Create output directory
out_dir <- "16..1MacMono.CellChat"
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

future::plan("multisession", workers = 4)

#===============================================================================
# 1. Data preparation and CellChat object construction
#===============================================================================

# Split data by group
sce_A <- subset(sce, tissue == "A")
sce_P <- subset(sce, tissue == "P")

# Function to create CellChat object
create_cellchat <- function(seurat_obj, group_name) {
  future::plan("sequential")
  memory.limit(size = 32000)
  
  data_input <- seurat_obj[["RNA"]]@data
  meta_data <- seurat_obj@meta.data[, c("tissue", "celltype_lv2")]
  colnames(meta_data) <- c("group", "labels")
  
  cellchat <- createCellChat(object = data_input, meta = meta_data, group.by = "labels")
  cellchat <- addMeta(cellchat, meta = meta_data)
  cellchat <- setIdent(cellchat, ident.use = "labels")
  
  CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse
  cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB
  
  cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat)
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
  cellchat <- projectData(cellchat, PPI.human)
  
  cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat)
  cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10)
  
  cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
  cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)
  
  cellchat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat)
  
  return(cellchat)
}

# Create CellChat objects for each group
cellchat_A <- create_cellchat(sce_A, "A")
cellchat_P <- create_cellchat(sce_P, "P")

# Save results
saveRDS(cellchat_A, "cellchat_A.rds")
saveRDS(cellchat_P, "cellchat_P.rds")

#===============================================================================
# 2. Merge CellChat objects for comparative analysis
#===============================================================================

cellchat.list <- list(P = cellchat_P, A = cellchat_A)
cellchat.merged <- mergeCellChat(cellchat.list, add.names = names(cellchat.list))

saveRDS(cellchat.list, "cellchat.list.Rds")
saveRDS(cellchat.merged, "cellchat.merged.Rds")

#===============================================================================
# 3. Differential communication analysis
#===============================================================================

p1 <- compareInteractions(
  cellchat.merged,
  show.legend = FALSE,
  group = c(1, 2),
  color.use = c("#8491B4FF", "#F39B7FFF")
)

p2 <- compareInteractions(
  cellchat.merged,
  show.legend = FALSE,
  group = c(1, 2),
  measure = "weight",
  color.use = c("#8491B4FF", "#F39B7FFF")
)

fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, p_filename = "01.interaction_comparison.pdf", p = p1, height = 3, width = 3)
fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, p_filename = "01.interaction_comparison_weight.pdf", p = p2, height = 3, width = 3)

# Differential interaction network
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))
pdf("02.diff_interaction_network.pdf", width = 15, height = 10)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), xpd = TRUE)
netVisual_diffInteraction(cellchat.merged, weight.scale = TRUE, title.name = "Interaction number")
netVisual_diffInteraction(cellchat.merged, weight.scale = TRUE, measure = "weight", title.name = "Interaction weight")
dev.off()

# Differential interaction heatmap
pdf("diff_interaction_heatmap.pdf", width = 14, height = 12)
netVisual_heatmap(cellchat.merged)
dev.off()

# Global interaction network comparison
pdf("03.circle_interaction_comparison.pdf", width = 20, height = 10)
weight.max <- getMaxWeight(cellchat.list, attribute = c("idents", "count"))
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), xpd = TRUE)
for (i in 1:length(cellchat.list)) {
  netVisual_circle(
    cellchat.list[[i]]@net$count,
    weight.scale = TRUE,
    label.edge = TRUE,
    edge.weight.max = weight.max[2],
    edge.width.max = 10,
    title.name = paste0("Number of interactions - ", names(cellchat.list)[i])
  )
}
dev.off()

# Signaling role comparison
pdf("04.signaling_role_comparison.pdf", width = 12, height = 10)
num.link <- sapply(cellchat.list, function(x) {
  rowSums(x@net$count) + colSums(x@net$count) - diag(x@net$count)
})
weight.MinMax <- c(min(num.link), max(num.link))
gg <- list()
for (i in 1:length(cellchat.list)) {
  gg[[i]] <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_scatter(
    cellchat.list[[i]],
    title = names(cellchat.list)[i],
    weight.MinMax = weight.MinMax
  )
}
patchwork::wrap_plots(plots = gg)
dev.off()

#===============================================================================
# 4. Identify pathways with the largest changes
#===============================================================================

pdf("pathway_strength_comparison.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)
rankNet(cellchat.merged, mode = "comparison", stacked = TRUE, do.stat = TRUE)
dev.off()

pdf("up_down_pathways.pdf", width = 12, height = 10)
gg1 <- rankNet(cellchat.merged, mode = "comparison", stacked = FALSE, do.stat = TRUE)
gg2 <- rankNet(cellchat.merged, mode = "comparison", stacked = TRUE, do.stat = TRUE)
gg1 + gg2
dev.off()

pathway.union <- union(cellchat_A@netP$pathways, cellchat_P@netP$pathways)
pathway.changes <- rankNet(cellchat.merged, mode = "comparison", stacked = FALSE, do.stat = TRUE)$data

top_pathways <- pathway.changes %>%
  group_by(pathway) %>%
  summarize(diff = abs(sum(A) - sum(P))) %>%
  arrange(desc(diff)) %>%
  head(5) %>%
  pull(pathway)

pathway_table <- data.frame(
  Pathway = top_pathways,
  P_strength = sapply(top_pathways, function(x) sum(pathway.changes$P[pathway.changes$pathway == x])),
  A_strength = sapply(top_pathways, function(x) sum(pathway.changes$A[pathway.changes$pathway == x])),
  Log2FC = sapply(top_pathways, function(x) log2(
    sum(pathway.changes$A[pathway.changes$pathway == x]) /
      sum(pathway.changes$P[pathway.changes$pathway == x])
  ))
)

write.csv(pathway_table, "top_changed_pathways.csv", row.names = FALSE)

#===============================================================================
# 5. Detailed communication patterns of key pathways
#===============================================================================

pdf("top_pathway_analysis.pdf", width = 15, height = 15)
for (i in 1:length(top_pathways)) {
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2), xpd = TRUE)
  weight.max <- getMaxWeight(cellchat.list, slot.name = c("netP"), attribute = top_pathways[i])
  for (j in 1:length(cellchat.list)) {
    netVisual_aggregate(
      cellchat.list[[j]],
      signaling = top_pathways[i],
      layout = "circle",
      edge.weight.max = weight.max[1],
      edge.width.max = 10,
      signaling.name = paste(top_pathways[i], names(cellchat.list)[j])
    )
  }
  
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2), xpd = TRUE)
  for (j in 1:length(cellchat.list)) {
    netVisual_aggregate(
      cellchat.list[[j]],
      signaling = top_pathways[i],
      layout = "chord",
      signaling.name = paste(top_pathways[i], names(cellchat.list)[j])
    )
  }
  
  netVisual_heatmap(
    cellchat.merged,
    signaling = top_pathways[i],
    title.name = paste0(top_pathways[i], " signaling changes")
  )
}
dev.off()

#===============================================================================
# 6. Ligand-receptor contribution analysis
#===============================================================================

pdf("LR_contribution.pdf", width = 12, height = 18)
for (i in 1:length(top_pathways)) {
  netAnalysis_contribution(cellchat_A, signaling = top_pathways[i])
  netAnalysis_contribution(cellchat_P, signaling = top_pathways[i])
  
  pairLR.use <- extractEnrichedLR(cellchat.merged, signaling = top_pathways[i], geneLR.return = FALSE)
  
  netVisual_bubble(
    cellchat.merged,
    pairLR.use = pairLR.use,
    comparison = c(1, 2),
    angle.x = 45,
    title.name = paste0(top_pathways[i], " ligand-receptor pairs")
  )
}
dev.off()

#===============================================================================
# 7. Communication pattern identification
#===============================================================================

pdf("outgoing_patterns.pdf", width = 12, height = 10)
selectK(cellchat_A, pattern = "outgoing")
nPatterns <- 3
cellchat_A <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat_A, pattern = "outgoing", k = nPatterns)
netAnalysis_river(cellchat_A, pattern = "outgoing")
netAnalysis_dot(cellchat_A, pattern = "outgoing")
dev.off()

pdf("incoming_patterns.pdf", width = 12, height = 10)
selectK(cellchat_A, pattern = "incoming")
nPatterns <- 3
cellchat_A <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat_A, pattern = "incoming", k = nPatterns)
netAnalysis_river(cellchat_A, pattern = "incoming")
netAnalysis_dot(cellchat_A, pattern = "incoming")
dev.off()

# The same analysis can be applied to group P if needed

#===============================================================================
# 8. Signaling pathway similarity analysis
#===============================================================================

cellchat_A <- computeNetSimilarity(cellchat_A, type = "functional")
cellchat_A <- netEmbedding(cellchat_A, type = "functional")
cellchat_A <- netClustering(cellchat_A, type = "functional")

cellchat_P <- computeNetSimilarity(cellchat_P, type = "functional")
cellchat_P <- netEmbedding(cellchat_P, type = "functional")
cellchat_P <- netClustering(cellchat_P, type = "functional")

cellchat.merged <- computeNetSimilarityPairwise(cellchat.merged, type = "functional")
cellchat.merged <- netEmbedding(cellchat.merged, type = "functional")
cellchat.merged <- netClustering(cellchat.merged, type = "functional")

pdf("pathway_similarity.pdf", width = 12, height = 10)
netVisual_embedding(cellchat_A, type = "functional", label.size = 3.5)
netVisual_embedding(cellchat_P, type = "functional", label.size = 3.5)
netVisual_embeddingPairwise(cellchat.merged, type = "functional", label.size = 3.5)
dev.off()

#===============================================================================
# 9. Detailed communication patterns of major cell types
#===============================================================================

mac_subtypes <- levels(sce$celltype_lv2)[grep("^Mac|^Mono", levels(sce$celltype_lv2))]

pdf("macrophage_communication.pdf", width = 15, height = 15)
for (cell_type in mac_subtypes) {
  netVisual_bubble(
    cellchat.merged,
    sources.use = cell_type,
    comparison = c(1, 2),
    angle.x = 45,
    title.name = paste0(cell_type, " as signal source")
  )
  
  netVisual_bubble(
    cellchat.merged,
    targets.use = cell_type,
    comparison = c(1, 2),
    angle.x = 45,
    title.name = paste0(cell_type, " as signal target")
  )
  
  netAnalysis_signalingChanges_scatter(
    cellchat.merged,
    idents.use = cell_type,
    comparison = c(2, 1),
    title.name = paste0("Signaling changes in ", cell_type)
  )
}
dev.off()

#===============================================================================
# 10. Bilateral bar plot of interaction counts
#===============================================================================

mac_subtype_of_interest <- mac_subtypes[1]

# Ligand-providing interactions
A_MAC_ligand <- netVisual_bubble(
  cellchat_A,
  sources.use = c(mac_subtype_of_interest),
  targets.use = setdiff(levels(cellchat_A@idents), mac_subtype_of_interest)
)

P_MAC_ligand <- netVisual_bubble(
  cellchat_P,
  sources.use = c(mac_subtype_of_interest),
  targets.use = setdiff(levels(cellchat_P@idents), mac_subtype_of_interest)
)

# Receptor-providing interactions
A_MAC_receptor <- netVisual_bubble(
  cellchat_A,
  sources.use = setdiff(levels(cellchat_A@idents), mac_subtype_of_interest),
  targets.use = c(mac_subtype_of_interest)
)

P_MAC_receptor <- netVisual_bubble(
  cellchat_P,
  sources.use = setdiff(levels(cellchat_P@idents), mac_subtype_of_interest),
  targets.use = c(mac_subtype_of_interest)
)

ligand_cellchat <- cbind(
  as.data.frame(table(A_MAC_ligand$data$target)),
  as.data.frame(table(P_MAC_ligand$data$target))
)
ligand_cellchat <- ligand_cellchat[, -3]
colnames(ligand_cellchat) <- c("celltype", "A", "P")
ligand_cellchat$ratio <- ligand_cellchat$P / ligand_cellchat$A
ligand_cellchat$ratio <- log2(ligand_cellchat$ratio)

receptor_cellchat <- cbind(
  as.data.frame(table(A_MAC_receptor$data$source)),
  as.data.frame(table(P_MAC_receptor$data$source))
)
receptor_cellchat <- receptor_cellchat[, -3]
colnames(receptor_cellchat) <- c("celltype", "A", "P")
receptor_cellchat$ratio <- receptor_cellchat$P / receptor_cellchat$A
receptor_cellchat$ratio <- log2(receptor_cellchat$ratio)

ligand <- melt(
  ligand_cellchat,
  id.vars = c("celltype"),
  measure.vars = 2:3,
  variable.name = c("group"),
  value.name = "number"
)
ligand$number <- ifelse(ligand$group == "A", ligand$number * -1, ligand$number * 1)
ligand$ratio <- c(ligand_cellchat$ratio, ligand_cellchat$ratio)
ligand$ratio_color <- ifelse(ligand$ratio > 0, "red", "black")

pdf("bilateral_barplot_ligand.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
p_ligand <- ggplot(data = ligand, aes(x = celltype)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = number, fill = group)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = ratio * 30, color = ratio_color), shape = 16, size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "# of interaction pairs",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans = ~ . / 30,
      name = "Log2(# of interaction pairs in P / # of interaction pairs in A)"
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#119781", "#3B5081")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "red")) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(position = c("top")) +
  geom_text(
    data = ligand[which(ligand$number > 0), ],
    aes(y = number, label = abs(number)),
    hjust = 1.2, size = 4, color = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = ligand[which(ligand$number < 0), ],
    aes(y = number, label = abs(number)),
    hjust = -0.2, size = 4, color = "white"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.y.right = element_blank()
  ) +
  annotate(geom = "text", label = "A\ngroup", x = 4, y = -20, size = 4, color = "#119781") +
  annotate(geom = "text", label = "P\ngroup", x = 4, y = 30, size = 4, color = "#3B5081") +
  ggtitle(paste0("Cell types interacting with ", mac_subtype_of_interest, " (providing ligand)")) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(50, 50, 50, 50))
print(p_ligand)
dev.off()

# A similar plot can be generated for receptor interactions if needed

#===============================================================================
# 11. Correlation with metabolic pathways or key genes
#===============================================================================

if (FALSE) {
  communication_strength <- as.data.frame(cellchat_A@net$weight)
  
  cor_results <- list()
  for (pathway in top_pathways) {
    pathway_strength <- extractSubNetByPathway(cellchat_A, signaling = pathway)
  }
}

# Summary table
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Pathway = character(),
  Status = character(),
  Key_LR_Pairs = character(),
  Main_Sources = character(),
  Main_Targets = character(),
  Communication_Pattern = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (i in 1:length(top_pathways)) {
  pathway <- top_pathways[i]
  
  fc <- log2(
    sum(pathway.changes$A[pathway.changes$pathway == pathway]) /
      sum(pathway.changes$P[pathway.changes$pathway == pathway])
  )
  status <- ifelse(fc > 0, "Up in A", "Up in P")
  
  pairLR <- extractEnrichedLR(cellchat.merged, signaling = pathway, geneLR.return = FALSE)
  key_LR <- paste(head(pairLR$interaction_name, 3), collapse = ", ")
  
  cells_involved <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(cellchat_A, pattern = "outgoing", signaling = pathway)
  main_sources <- "Not extracted"
  main_targets <- "Not extracted"
  comm_pattern <- "Not determined"
  
  summary_table <- rbind(
    summary_table,
    data.frame(
      Pathway = pathway,
      Status = status,
      Key_LR_Pairs = key_LR,
      Main_Sources = main_sources,
      Main_Targets = main_targets,
      Communication_Pattern = comm_pattern,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
}

write.csv(summary_table, "pathway_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save all objects
save(cellchat_A, cellchat_P, cellchat.merged, cellchat.list, file = "cellchat_complete_analysis.RData")
```

```{r}
# Program: Compute differential logFC for df.net and df.netp

df.net.a_renamed <- df.net.a %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    prob_order_a = dplyr::dense_rank(dplyr::desc(prob))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    prob_a = prob,
    pval_a = pval
  ) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(
    prob_a, pval_a, prob_order_a,
    .after = dplyr::last_col()
  )

df.net.p_renamed <- df.net.p %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    prob_order_p = dplyr::dense_rank(dplyr::desc(prob))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    prob_p = prob,
    pval_p = pval
  ) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(
    prob_p, pval_p, prob_order_p,
    .after = dplyr::last_col()
  )

df.net_merged <- dplyr::full_join(
  df.net.a_renamed,
  df.net.p_renamed,
  by = c(
    "source", "target", "ligand", "receptor",
    "interaction_name", "interaction_name_2",
    "pathway_name", "annotation", "evidence"
  )
)

df.net <- df.net_merged %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(prob_a) & !is.na(prob_p)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    prob_log2fc = log2(prob_a / prob_p)
  )

df.net.only_a <- df.net_merged %>%

df.net.only_p <- df.net_merged %>%

fxx.netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap <- function(
    cellchat,
    filename,
    color.heatmap = "RdPu",
    width = 8,
    height = 12,
    ppi = 300,
    final_folder = "test",
    mfrow = c(1, 1),
    mar = c(2, 8, 2, 2)
) {
  p1 <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
    cellchat,
    pattern = "all",
    color.heatmap = color.heatmap,
    width = width,
    height = height
  )
  p2 <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
    cellchat,
    pattern = "outgoing",

fxx.netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap.choose_celltypes2plot <- function(
    object,
    signaling = NULL,
    pattern = c("outgoing", "incoming", "all"),
    slot.name = "netP",
    color.use = NULL,
    color.heatmap = "BuGn",
    title = NULL,
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    font.size = 8,
    font.size.title = 10,
    cluster.rows = FALSE,
    cluster.cols = FALSE,
    celltype_choosen = NULL
) {
  pattern <- match.arg(pattern)
  if (length(slot(object, slot.name)$centr) == 0) {
    stop("Please run `netAnalysis_computeCentrality` to compute the network centrality scores! ")
  }

  centr <- slot(object, slot.name)$centr
  outgoing <- matrix(0, nrow = nlevels(object@idents), ncol = length(centr))
  incoming <- matrix(0, nrow = nlevels(object@idents), ncol = length(centr))
  dimnames(outgoing) <- list(levels(object@idents), names(centr))
  dimnames(incoming) <- dimnames(outgoing)

  for (i in 1:length(centr)) {
    outgoing[, i] <- centr[[i]]$outdeg
    incoming[, i] <- centr[[i]]$indeg
  }

  if (pattern == "outgoing") {
    mat <- t(outgoing)
    legend.name <- "Outgoing"
  } else if (pattern == "incoming") {
    mat <- t(incoming)
    legend.name <- "Incoming"
  } else {
    mat <- t(outgoing + incoming)
    legend.name <- "Overall"
  }

  if (is.null(title)) {
    title <- paste0(legend.name, " signaling patterns")
  } else {
    title <- paste0(legend.name, " signaling patterns - ", title)
  }

  if (!is.null(signaling)) {
    mat1 <- mat[rownames(mat) %in% signaling, , drop = FALSE]
    mat <- matrix(0, nrow = length(signaling), ncol = ncol(mat))
    idx <- match(rownames(mat1), signaling)
    mat[idx[!is.na(idx)], ] <- mat1
    dimnames(mat) <- list(signaling, colnames(mat1))
  }

  if (!is.null(celltype_choosen)) {
    available_celltypes <- colnames(mat)
    celltype_choosen <- celltype_choosen[celltype_choosen %in% available_celltypes]
    if (length(celltype_choosen) == 0) {
      stop("None of the specified cell types found in the data!")
    }
    mat <- mat[, celltype_choosen, drop = FALSE]
  }

  mat.ori <- mat

  if (ncol(mat) == 1) {
    global_max <- max(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (global_max > 0) {
      mat <- mat / global_max
    }
  } else {
    mat <- sweep(mat, 1L, apply(mat, 1, max), "/", check.margin = FALSE)
  }
  mat[mat == 0] <- NA

  if (is.null(color.use)) {
    if (ncol(mat) == 1) {
      color.use <- c("#1f77b4")
    } else {
      color.use <- scPalette(length(colnames(mat)))
    }
  }

  if (length(color.use) < ncol(mat)) {
    color.use <- rep(color.use, length.out = ncol(mat))
  }

  color.heatmap.use <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
    RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 9, name = color.heatmap)
  )(100)

  df <- data.frame(group = colnames(mat))
  rownames(df) <- colnames(mat)
  names(color.use) <- colnames(mat)

  col_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    df = df,
    col = list(group = color.use),
    which = "column",
    show_legend = FALSE,
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    simple_anno_size = grid::unit(0.2, "cm")
  )

  ha2 <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Strength = anno_barplot(
      colSums(mat.ori),
      border = FALSE,
      gp = gpar(fill = color.use, col = color.use)
    ),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE
  )

  pSum <- rowSums(mat.ori)
  pSum.original <- pSum
  pSum <- -1 / log(pSum)
  pSum[is.na(pSum)] <- 0
  idx1 <- which(is.infinite(pSum) | pSum < 0)
  if (length(idx1) > 0) {
    values.assign <- seq(max(pSum) * 1.1, max(pSum) * 1.5, length.out = length(idx1))
    position <- sort(pSum.original[idx1], index.return = TRUE)$ix
    pSum[idx1] <- values.assign[match(1:length(idx1), position)]
  }

  ha1 <- rowAnnotation(
    Strength = anno_barplot(pSum, border = FALSE),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE
  )

  min_val <- min(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_val <- max(mat, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (is.na(min_val) || is.na(max_val) || min_val == max_val) {
    if (is.na(min_val) || is.na(max_val)) {
      legend.break <- c(0, 1)
    } else {
      if (min_val == 0) {
        legend.break <- c(0, 0.1)
      } else {
        legend.break <- c(min_val * 0.9, min_val * 1.1)
      }
    }
  } else {
    legend.break <- c(round(min_val, digits = 1), round(max_val, digits = 1))
    if (legend.break[1] == legend.break[2]) {
      legend.break[2] <- legend.break[1] + 0.1
    }
  }

  adjusted_width <- if (ncol(mat) == 1 && width < 3) 3 else width

  ht1 <- Heatmap(
    mat,
    col = color.heatmap.use,
    na_col = "white",
    name = "Relative strength",
    bottom_annotation = col_annotation,
    top_annotation = ha2,
    right_annotation = ha1,
    cluster_rows = cluster.rows,
    cluster_columns = cluster.cols,
    row_names_side = "left",
    row_names_rot = 0,
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = font.size),
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = font.size),
    width = unit(adjusted_width, "cm"),
    height = unit(height, "cm"),
    column_title = title,
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = font.size.title),
    column_names_rot = 90,
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "plain"),
      title_position = "leftcenter-rot",
      border = NA,
      at = legend.break,
      legend_height = unit(20, "mm"),
      labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
      grid_width = unit(2, "mm")
    )
  )

  return(ht1)
}

fxx.netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap_with_selection <- function(
    cellchat,
    filename,
    color.heatmap = "RdPu",
    width = 8,
    height = 12,
    ppi = 300,
    final_folder = "test",
    celltype_choosen = NULL
) {
  p1 <- fxx.netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap.choose_celltypes2plot(
    cellchat,
    pattern = "all",
    color.heatmap = color.heatmap,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    celltype_choosen = celltype_choosen
  )
  p2 <- fxx.netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap.choose_celltypes2plot(
    cellchat,
    pattern = "outgoing",
    color.heatmap = color.heatmap,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    celltype_choosen = celltype_choosen
  )
  p3 <- fxx.netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap.choose_celltypes2plot(
    cellchat,
    pattern = "incoming",
    color.heatmap = color.heatmap,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    celltype_choosen = celltype_choosen
  )

  fxx.save_baseplot_obj2res(
    final_folder = final_folder,
    p = p1,
    height = height,
    width = width,
    dpi = ppi,
    p_filename = paste0(filename, ".all")
  )
  fxx.save_baseplot_obj2res(
    final_folder = final_folder,
    p = p2,
    height = height,
    width = width,
    dpi = ppi,
    p_filename = paste0(filename, ".outgoing")
  )
  fxx.save_baseplot_obj2res(
    final_folder = final_folder,
    p = p3,
    height = height,
    width = width,
    dpi = ppi,
    p_filename = paste0(filename, ".incoming")
  )
}
```

```{r Epithelial cell: Resolution selection}
##============================================================================##
# Program: Epithelial cell

library(ggplot2)

setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "31.0.epi"))
sce <- readRDS("epi.rds")

sce <- RunTSNE(sce, reduction = "harmony")

out_dir <- "31.0.epi"
## clustree
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder,  out_dir))
library(clustree)
library(patchwork)
p1 <- clustree(sce, prefix = "RNA_snn_res.")+coord_flip()
fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res( out_dir, p_filename = "03.clustree(0.1_0.1_2)", p1, 15, 39)
# Plot all resolutions with tSNE and UMAP
res_values <- grep("RNA_snn_res", colnames(sce@meta.data), value = TRUE)
for(res in res_values) {
  p1 <- DimPlot(sce, reduction = "tsne", group.by = res, label = TRUE)
  p2 <- DimPlot(sce, reduction = "umap", group.by = res, label = TRUE)
  p3 <- DimPlot(sce, reduction = "tsne", group.by = res, label = TRUE, split.by = "tissue")
  p4 <- DimPlot(sce, reduction = "umap", group.by = res, label = TRUE, split.by = "tissue")
  # ---- 设置图片保存参数
  W1 <- 6; H1 <- 6; 
  W2 <- 6; H2 <- 36
  fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, p_filename = paste0("03.DimPlot.tsne.", res), p1, width = W1, height = H1)
  fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, p_filename = paste0("03.DimPlot.umap.", res), p2, width = W1, height = H1) 
  fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, p_filename = paste0("03.DimPlot.tsne.", res, ".tissue"), p3, width = W2, height = H2)
  fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(out_dir, p_filename = paste0("03.DimPlot.umap.", res, ".tissue"), p4, width = W2, height = H2)
}
```

```{r Epithelial cell: Subcelltype enrichment}
##----------------------------------------------------------------------------##
## Program: FindAllMarkers() + COSG()
## Output: DEGs.xlsx, GSEA.pdf/png, DoHeatmap.pdf/png
##----------------------------------------------------------------------------##
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "31.1.epi.annotation"))
sce <- readRDS("sce.Rds")

# Identify characteristic genes
sce@active.ident <- sce$celltype_lv2
Idents(sce) %>% unique()

library(COSG)
cosg_markers <- cosg(
  sce,
  groups = "all",
  assay = "RNA",
  slot = "data",
  mu = 1,
  n_genes_user = 500
)
degs <- cosg_markers$names

# Save marker genes
out_dir <- "31.2.epi_500cosg"
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))
saveRDS(cosg_markers, file = "01.cosg_markers.Rds")
writexl::write_xlsx(cosg_markers$names, path = "01.cosg_markers.xlsx")

# Load enrichment functions
setwd(file.path(root_path, code_folder, "lib"))
source("fxx.human2mouseANDmouse2human.R")
source("fxx.run_enrichment_multibase.R")
source("fxx.save_enrichment_to_excel.R")

##----------------------------------------------------------------------------##
## Program: Enrichment analysis for upregulated genes in each cluster
## Output: Individual Excel files for each cluster and one summary Excel file
##----------------------------------------------------------------------------##
out_dir <- "31.2.epi_500cosg.enrich"
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

clusters <- unique(colnames(degs))
all_enrichment_results <- list()

for (cluster_id in clusters) {
  genes <- degs[, cluster_id]

  if (length(genes) < 5) {
    next
  }

  enrichment_results <- fxx.run_enrichment_multibase.uniLine(
    genes = genes,
    species = "mouse",
    p_cutoff = 0.05,
    q_cutoff = 0.2
  )

  all_enrichment_results[[paste0("cluster", cluster_id)]] <- enrichment_results$df_results

  cluster_dir <- paste0("cluster", cluster_id)
  setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir, cluster_dir))

  saveRDS(
    enrichment_results,
    file = paste0("01.enrichment_results.(cluster", cluster_id, ").Rds")
  )

  output_file <- paste0("01.enrichment_results.(cluster", cluster_id, ").xlsx")
  wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()

  for (name in names(enrichment_results$df_results)) {
    if (!is.null(enrichment_results$df_results[[name]]) &&
        nrow(enrichment_results$df_results[[name]]) > 0) {
      sheet_name <- name
      openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
      openxlsx::writeData(
        wb,
        sheet = sheet_name,
        x = enrichment_results$df_results[[name]]
      )
      openxlsx::addFilter(
        wb,
        sheet_name,
        row = 1,
        cols = 1:ncol(enrichment_results$df_results[[name]])
      )
      openxlsx::freezePane(wb, sheet_name, firstRow = TRUE)
      openxlsx::setColWidths(
        wb,
        sheet_name,
        cols = 1:ncol(enrichment_results$df_results[[name]]),
        widths = "auto"
      )
    }
  }

  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, output_file, overwrite = TRUE)
}

# Save summary Excel
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))
summary_wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
all_databases <- unique(unlist(lapply(all_enrichment_results, names)))

for (db in all_databases) {
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(summary_wb, db)
  summary_df <- data.frame()

  for (cluster_name in names(all_enrichment_results)) {
    if (db %in% names(all_enrichment_results[[cluster_name]]) &&
        !is.null(all_enrichment_results[[cluster_name]][[db]]) &&
        nrow(all_enrichment_results[[cluster_name]][[db]]) > 0) {

      curr_df <- all_enrichment_results[[cluster_name]][[db]] %>%
        dplyr::select(Description, p.adjust) %>%
        dplyr::rename(!!cluster_name := p.adjust)

      if (nrow(summary_df) == 0) {
        summary_df <- curr_df
      } else {
        summary_df <- dplyr::full_join(summary_df, curr_df, by = "Description")
      }
    }
  }

  if (nrow(summary_df) > 0) {
    if (ncol(summary_df) > 2) {
      summary_df <- summary_df[order(summary_df[[2]], na.last = TRUE), ]
    }

    openxlsx::writeData(summary_wb, db, x = summary_df)
    openxlsx::addFilter(summary_wb, db, row = 1, cols = 1:ncol(summary_df))
    openxlsx::freezePane(summary_wb, db, firstRow = TRUE)
    openxlsx::setColWidths(summary_wb, db, cols = 1:ncol(summary_df), widths = "auto")
  }
}

openxlsx::saveWorkbook(summary_wb, "02.enrichment_summary.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

##----------------------------------------------------------------------------##
## Program: DimPlot for epithelial clusters
##----------------------------------------------------------------------------##
p <- DimPlot(
  sce_subset,
  reduction = "umap",
  cols = cell_type_colors,
  group.by = "celltype_lv2"
)

out_dir <- "32.2.epi_dimplot"
fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(
  out_dir,
  p_filename = "res0.4.celltype_lv2(exclude_mac_T)",
  p,
  height = 4,
  5,
  600
)
```

```{r Epithelial cell - Macrophage/Monocyte CellChat (Part1)}
library(tidyverse)
library(CellChat)

setwd(file.path(root_path, code_folder, "lib"))

source("fxx.baseplot_obj2.R")

source("fxx.sanitize_variable_name.R")

source("fxx.human2mouseANDmouse2human.R")

library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(CellChat)
library(slingshot)
library(irGSEA)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggtext)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggthemes)
library(ggsci)
library(ggalluvial)
library(data.table)

##============================================================================##
# Program: CellChat analysis for macrophage-epithelial communication
##============================================================================##

# Load macrophage single-cell data
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "11.5.Check_Cluster_anno"))
sce_mac <- readRDS("mac_mono_sce.Rds")

# Load epithelial single-cell data
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "31.1.epi.annotation"))
sce_epi <- readRDS("sce.Rds")

# Merge Seurat objects
sce <- merge(sce_mac, sce_epi)

## Step 1: Create CellChat object
data.input <- GetAssayData(sce, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")
identity <- subset(sce@meta.data, select = "celltype_lv2")
cellchat <- createCellChat(
  object = data.input,
  meta = identity,
  group.by = "celltype_lv2"
)

## Step 2: Set CellChat database
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse
cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB

## Optional: restrict analysis to specific signaling categories
# CellChatDB.use <- subsetDB(CellChatDB, search = "Secreted Signaling")
# cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB.use

## Step 3: CellChat analysis
# Subset signaling genes to reduce computation
cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat)

# Parallel computing
future::plan("multiprocess", workers = 4)

# Identify overexpressed genes and interactions
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)

# Project data onto PPI network
cellchat <- projectData(cellchat, PPI.human)

## Infer cell-cell communication
cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, raw.use = TRUE)

# Filter out communications involving rare cell groups
cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 3)

# Extract inferred communication at ligand-receptor level
df.net <- subsetCommunication(cellchat)

# Optional examples for subsetting communication results
df.net <- subsetCommunication(cellchat, sources.use = c(1, 2), targets.use = c(4, 5))
df.net <- subsetCommunication(cellchat, signaling = c("WNT", "TGFb"))

## Infer communication at signaling pathway level
cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)

# Aggregate communication network
cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)

## Visualize aggregated communication network
groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents))

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), xpd = TRUE)
netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$count,
  vertex.weight = groupSize,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE,
  title.name = "Number of interactions"
)
netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$weight,
  vertex.weight = groupSize,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE,
  title.name = "Interaction weights/strength"
)

## Visualize outgoing interaction strength for each cell group
mat <- cellchat@net$weight
par(mfrow = c(3, 3), xpd = TRUE)
for (i in 1:nrow(mat)) {
  mat2 <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = nrow(mat),
    ncol = ncol(mat),
    dimnames = dimnames(mat)
  )
  mat2[i, ] <- mat[i, ]
  netVisual_circle(
    mat2,
    vertex.weight = groupSize,
    weight.scale = TRUE,
    edge.weight.max = max(mat),
    title.name = rownames(mat)[i]
  )
}

## Visualize outgoing interaction counts for each cell group
mat <- cellchat@net$count
par(mfrow = c(3, 3), xpd = TRUE)
for (i in 1:nrow(mat)) {
  mat2 <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = nrow(mat),
    ncol = ncol(mat),
    dimnames = dimnames(mat)
  )
  mat2[i, ] <- mat[i, ]
  netVisual_circle(
    mat2,
    vertex.weight = groupSize,
    weight.scale = TRUE,
    edge.weight.max = max(mat),
    title.name = rownames(mat)[i]
  )
}
```

```{r Epithelial cell - Macrophage/Monocyte CellChat (Part2)}
##============================================================================##
# Program: Macrophage-epithelial CellChat analysis
##============================================================================##

out_dir <- "33.1.Mac-Epi_CellChat"

sce_A <- subset(sce, tissue == "A")
sce_P <- subset(sce, tissue == "P")

setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

create_cellchat <- function(seurat_obj, group_name) {
  future::plan("sequential")
  memory.limit(size = 32000)
  
  data_input <- seurat_obj[["RNA"]]@data
  meta_data <- seurat_obj@meta.data[, c("tissue", "celltype_lv2")]
  colnames(meta_data) <- c("group", "labels")
  
  cellchat <- createCellChat(object = data_input, meta = meta_data, group.by = "labels")
  cellchat <- addMeta(cellchat, meta = meta_data)
  cellchat <- setIdent(cellchat, ident.use = "labels")
  
  CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse
  cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB
  
  cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat)
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
  cellchat <- projectData(cellchat, PPI.human)
  
  cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat)
  cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10)
  cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
  cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)
  cellchat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat)
  
  return(cellchat)
}
```

```{r T cell - Macrophage/Monocyte CellChat (Part2)}
##============================================================================##
# Program: T cell to monocyte/macrophage communication analysis using CellChat
##============================================================================##

out_dir <- "22.1.T_MacMono_CellChat"

sce_A <- subset(sce, tissue == "A")
sce_P <- subset(sce, tissue == "P")

setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

create_cellchat <- function(seurat_obj, group_name) {
  future::plan("sequential")
  memory.limit(size = 32000)

  data_input <- seurat_obj[["RNA"]]@data
  meta_data <- seurat_obj@meta.data[, c("tissue", "celltype_lv2")]
  colnames(meta_data) <- c("group", "labels")

  cellchat <- createCellChat(object = data_input, meta = meta_data, group.by = "labels")
  cellchat <- addMeta(cellchat, meta = meta_data)
  cellchat <- setIdent(cellchat, ident.use = "labels")

  CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse
  cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB

  cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat)
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
  cellchat <- projectData(cellchat, PPI.human)

  cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat)
  cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10)

  cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
  cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)

  cellchat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat)

  return(cellchat)
}

cellchat_A <- create_cellchat(sce_A, "A")
cellchat_P <- create_cellchat(sce_P, "P")

saveRDS(cellchat_A, "cellchat_A.rds")
saveRDS(cellchat_P, "cellchat_P.rds")

cellchat.list <- list(P = cellchat_P, A = cellchat_A)
cellchat.merged <- mergeCellChat(cellchat.list, add.names = names(cellchat.list))

saveRDS(cellchat.list, "cellchat.list.rds")
saveRDS(cellchat.merged, "cellchat.merged.rds")

##============================================================================##
# Global differential analysis
##============================================================================##

cellchat <- cellchat.merged

sce_A <- subset(sce, tissue == "A")
sce_P <- subset(sce, tissue == "P")

# 1. Global comparison: interaction number and interaction strength
p1 <- compareInteractions(cellchat, show.legend = FALSE, group = c(1, 2))
p2 <- compareInteractions(cellchat, show.legend = FALSE, group = c(1, 2), measure = "weight")

fxx.save_baseplot_obj2res(out_dir, p_filename = "11.1_interaction_count_bar", p = p1, height = 3, width = 2, dpi = 600)
fxx.save_baseplot_obj2res(out_dir, p_filename = "11.2_interaction_weight_bar", p = p2, height = 3, width = 2, dpi = 600)

# 2. Cell subgroup-level communication differences
# 2.1 Differential interaction network
p2.1 <- netVisual_diffInteraction(cellchat, weight.scale = TRUE)
p2.2 <- netVisual_diffInteraction(cellchat, weight.scale = TRUE, measure = "weight")

fxx.save_baseplot_obj2res(out_dir, p_filename = "21.1_interaction_count_circle", p = p2.1, height = 10, width = 10, dpi = 600)
fxx.save_baseplot_obj2res(out_dir, p_filename = "21.2_interaction_weight_circle", p = p2.2, height = 10, width = 10, dpi = 600)

# 2.2 Differential interaction heatmap
p3.1 <- netVisual_heatmap(cellchat)
p3.2 <- netVisual_heatmap(cellchat, measure = "weight")

fxx.save_baseplot_obj2res(out_dir, p_filename = "22.1_interaction_count_heatmap", p = p3.1, height = 10, width = 10, dpi = 600)
fxx.save_baseplot_obj2res(out_dir, p_filename = "22.2_interaction_weight_heatmap", p = p3.2, height = 10, width = 10, dpi = 600)

# 3. Pathway-level communication differences
# 3.1 Ranked signaling pathway comparison
p4.1 <- rankNet(cellchat, mode = "comparison", stacked = TRUE, do.stat = TRUE)
p4.2 <- rankNet(cellchat, mode = "comparison", stacked = FALSE, do.stat = TRUE)

fxx.save_baseplot_obj2res(out_dir, p_filename = "31.1_ranked_pathway_stacked", p = p4.1, height = 8, width = 3, dpi = 600)
fxx.save_baseplot_obj2res(out_dir, p_filename = "31.2_ranked_pathway_unstacked", p = p4.2, height = 8, width = 3, dpi = 600)

# 3.2 Outgoing signaling heatmap
i <- 1
pathway.union <- union(
  cellchat.list[[i]]@netP$pathways,
  cellchat.list[[i + 1]]@netP$pathways
)

ht1 <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(

)

ht2 <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(

)

# 3.3 Incoming signaling heatmap

fxx.save_baseplot_obj2res(out_dir, p_filename = "34.2_overall_signaling_heatmap_group2", p = ht6, height = 12, width = 5, dpi = 600)

# 4. Ligand-receptor level differential communication
p6 <- netVisual_bubble(

# 4.2 Upregulated and downregulated ligand-receptor pairs

  labs(title = title.name) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = size.text), axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"))
gg <- gg + scale_fill_manual(values = alpha(color.use, alpha = color.alpha), drop = FALSE)
gg <- gg + theme(legend.title = element_blank())

p2 <- gg

##============================================================================##
# Custom heatmap function
##============================================================================##

fxx.netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap <- function(
  object,
  signaling = NULL,
  pattern = c("outgoing", "incoming", "all"),
  slot.name = "netP",
  color.use = NULL,
  color.heatmap = "BuGn",
  title = NULL,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  font.size = 8,
  font.size.title = 10,
  cluster.rows = FALSE,
  cluster.cols = FALSE
) {
  pattern <- match.arg(pattern)

  if (length(slot(object, slot.name)$centr) == 0) {
    stop("Please run `netAnalysis_computeCentrality` first.")
  }

  centr <- slot(object, slot.name)$centr
  outgoing <- matrix(0, nrow = nlevels(object@idents), ncol = length(centr))
  incoming <- matrix(0, nrow = nlevels(object@idents), ncol = length(centr))
  dimnames(outgoing) <- list(levels(object@idents), names(centr))
  dimnames(incoming) <- dimnames(outgoing)

  for (i in 1:length(centr)) {
    outgoing[, i] <- centr[[i]]$outdeg
    incoming[, i] <- centr[[i]]$indeg
  }

  if (pattern == "outgoing") {
    mat <- t(outgoing)
    legend.name <- "Outgoing"
  } else if (pattern == "incoming") {
    mat <- t(incoming)
    legend.name <- "Incoming"
  } else if (pattern == "all") {
    mat <- t(outgoing + incoming)
    legend.name <- "Overall"
  }

  if (is.null(title)) {
    title <- paste0(legend.name, " signaling patterns")
  } else {
    title <- paste0(legend.name, " signaling patterns - ", title)
  }

  if (!is.null(signaling)) {
    mat1 <- mat[rownames(mat) %in% signaling, , drop = FALSE]
    mat <- matrix(0, nrow = length(signaling), ncol = ncol(mat))
    idx <- match(rownames(mat1), signaling)
    mat[idx[!is.na(idx)], ] <- mat1
    dimnames(mat) <- list(signaling, colnames(mat1))
  }

  mat.ori <- mat
  mat <- sweep(mat, 1L, apply(mat, 1, max), "/", check.margin = FALSE)
  mat[mat == 0] <- NA

  if (is.null(color.use)) {
    color.use <- scPalette(length(colnames(mat)))
  }

  color.heatmap.use <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
    RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 9, name = color.heatmap)
  )(100)

  df <- data.frame(group = colnames(mat))
  rownames(df) <- colnames(mat)
  names(color.use) <- colnames(mat)

  col_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    df = df,
    col = list(group = color.use),
    which = "column",
    show_legend = FALSE,
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    simple_anno_size = grid::unit(0.2, "cm")
  )

  ha2 <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Strength = anno_barplot(colSums(mat.ori), border = FALSE, gp = gpar(fill = color.use, col = color.use)),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE
  )

  pSum <- rowSums(mat.ori)
  pSum.original <- pSum
  pSum <- -1 / log(pSum)
  pSum[is.na(pSum)] <- 0

  idx1 <- which(is.infinite(pSum) | pSum < 0)
  if (length(idx1) > 0) {
    values.assign <- seq(max(pSum) * 1.1, max(pSum) * 1.5, length.out = length(idx1))
    position <- sort(pSum.original[idx1], index.return = TRUE)$ix
    pSum[idx1] <- values.assign[match(1:length(idx1), position)]
  }

  ha1 <- rowAnnotation(
    Strength = anno_barplot(pSum, border = FALSE),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE
  )

  if (min(mat, na.rm = TRUE) == max(mat, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    legend.break <- max(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    legend.break <- c(
      round(min(mat, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 1),
      round(max(mat, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 1)
    )
  }

  ht1 <- Heatmap(
    mat,
    col = color.heatmap.use,
    na_col = "white",
    name = "Relative strength",
    bottom_annotation = col_annotation,
    top_annotation = ha2,
    right_annotation = ha1,
    cluster_rows = cluster.rows,
    cluster_columns = cluster.rows,
    row_names_side = "left",
    row_names_rot = 0,
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = font.size),
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = font.size),
    width = unit(width, "cm"),
    height = unit(height, "cm"),
    column_title = title,
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = font.size.title),
    column_names_rot = 90,
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "plain"),
      title_position = "leftcenter-rot",
      border = NA,
      at = legend.break,
      legend_height = unit(20, "mm"),
      labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
      grid_width = unit(2, "mm")
    )
  )

  return(ht1)
}
```
